originalObjects.value: Miracle Veil — protective barrier; ally cannot drop below 1 HP for the duration (1/rest)

cards.name: Blessing of the Meek
cards.duration: Healing instantaneous; AC bonus until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: The target regains 2d6+M HP. If it was below half maximum HP before this healing, it also gains +2 AC until the start of your next regular turn. This spell cannot resurrect, remove Wounds or generate additional healing triggers beyond ordinary once-per-effect rules.

value.spell: Blessing of the Meek — heal + AC if HP < 50%

cards.name: Ward of Shelter
cards.effect: For up to 3 rounds, each target reduces the first damage it takes each round by 2 and has advantage on saving throws against Frightened. Starting another concentration effect ends the Ward normally.

value.spell: Ward of Shelter — allies +2 DR, resist fear

cards.name: Channel Life
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and one living ally within 30 feet
cards.effect: Choose X from 1 to Paladin level+M, limited so your current HP remains at least 1. Lose X HP; this loss cannot be reduced, redirected or prevented. The target regains X HP. This is a direct transfer, cannot exceed the target's maximum HP and cannot remove Wounds or create excess temporary HP.

value.spell: Channel Life — transfer HP from self to ally

cards.name: Sanctify Ground
cards.cost: 7 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance after the first pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius fixed zone centered within 30 feet; up to 3 allies per pulse
cards.effect: Resolve the first pulse on activation. On each of your next 2 regular turns you may pay 1 RP and a Bonus Action to produce another pulse. At each pulse choose up to 3 allies in the zone; each may end one of Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered, or immediately repeat one saving throw against a disease or finite-duration curse that normally allows a save. A creature receives at most one cleansing choice per pulse.

value.spell: Sanctify Ground — zone removes conditions each round

cards.name: Grace Reversal
cards.rangeAndTarget: One allied corpse in your Oath aura that died since the end of your previous regular turn
cards.frequency: At most once per creature per long rest
cards.effect: Trigger when you are reduced to 0 HP without being killed outright. One eligible allied corpse returns to life at 1 HP. You remain at 0 HP and resolve your own dying state normally. The revived ally retains Wounds and expended resources and must have a body capable of sustaining life. Grace Reversal cannot target you.

value.spell: Grace Reversal — revive fallen ally if you fall to 0 HP

cards.name: Grace Eternal
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies in your Oath aura
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Apply Miracle Veil to up to 3 allies in your aura without spending its short-rest use or RP. Once during this Veil for each affected ally, if damage would reduce it to 0 HP, it remains at 1 HP and immediately regains 2d8 HP. It also gains necrotic resistance until the end of its next turn. During Grace Eternal you may use Lay on Hands once without an Action, but must still spend points from your current Lay on Hands pool and may target only one creature.

originalObjects.value: Grace Eternal — once per day, Miracle Veil extends to all allies within your aura for 1 round; any ally reduced to 0 HP in that round rises to 1 HP instead, heals 2d8, and gains resistance to necrotic until end of next turn; you may Lay on Hands once as a free action during the veil.

cards.name: Death Touch — Life Drain
cards.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within melee reach; up to 2 additional living creatures within 5 feet
cards.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; rider once per turn
cards.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit the primary target takes necrotic damage equal to the declared Lay on Hands points. Then up to 2 other living creatures within 5 feet make Constitution saves, taking S necrotic damage on failure or half on success. Regain HP equal to half the total actual necrotic damage dealt by the secondary drain, rounded down, maximum S+M. Constructs and undead provide no healing.

originalObjects.value: Life Drain AoE — steal life from all creatures around you

cards.name: Healing Suppression
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
cards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
cards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
cards.effect: HP healing received by each selected creature is halved, rounded down. Temporary HP, damage prevention and resurrection are not healing for this effect. This suppression cannot reduce healing below 0 or convert prevented healing into damage.

originalObjects.value: Healing Suppression — all healing within aura reduced by 50%

cards.name: Exsanguinate
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living creatures in your Oath aura
cards.effect: Each target makes a Constitution save, taking 2 S d8 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. Regain HP equal to half the total actual damage dealt, rounded down, maximum Paladin level+M. Undead and constructs are unaffected and cannot be used to generate healing.

originalObjects.value: Exsanguinate — drain life in large radius, heal self for damage dealt

cards.name: Vengeful Smite
cards.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack
cards.duration: Vengeance Mark until end of your next regular turn
cards.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
cards.effect: Choose radiant or necrotic when you Smite; the entire Smite packet uses that type. After damage, apply Vengeance Mark until the end of your next regular turn. If the creature was already marked by you when this Smite began, add S flat damage to the Smite once. Applying a new mark refreshes but never stacks it.

originalObjects.value: Necrotic or radiant — bonus damage vs marked foes; applies Vengeance Mark

conductClauses: Pursue sworn enemies until justice is served or they surrender; let no convenience excuse a broken charge
Do not abandon allies to feed a private vendetta, for judgment that leaves the faithful behind is only rage
Accept the surrender of those who genuinely repent, and hold them to the peace they have asked for

cards.name: Aura of Judgment
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura currently marked by you
cards.duration: While conscious, marked and in aura
cards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
cards.effect: Selected marked enemies take -1 on saving throws and cannot Hide from you or benefit from mundane concealment against you. This does not reveal a creature behind total cover or defeat supernatural invisibility unless another feature does so.

originalObjects.value: Aura of Judgment — marked enemies within aura suffer −1 saves and cannot hide from you

cards.name: Judgment Brand
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature you can see within 60 feet
cards.effect: Brand the target for 3 rounds. It counts as Vengeance-marked. Your melee attacks against it score critical hits on natural 19-20, but this does not widen further with another 19-20 feature. When you move directly toward the branded target, ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. Once per round when the branded target willingly moves away from you, you may move up to 10 feet toward it as a Reaction without provoking opportunity attacks.

originalObjects.value: Judgment Brand — doom mark on target; bonus crit damage and pursuit (1/rest)

cards.name: Mark of Retribution
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it becomes Vengeance-marked. Your next Smite against it before the mark ends adds 1d8 damage of the Smite's chosen type. You have advantage on opportunity attacks against it while the mark persists.

value.spell: Mark of Retribution — mark one foe within 30 ft on failed Wis save; +1d8 smite damage vs marked and advantage on opportunity attacks against them until end of next turn

cards.name: Relentless Pursuit
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one creature currently marked by you
cards.effect: For up to 3 rounds, movement you take that directly reduces distance to the marked target ignores nonmagical difficult terrain and does not cost extra movement for climbing minor obstacles no higher than 5 feet. This does not grant teleportation, flight or movement through creatures or solid objects.

value.spell: Relentless Pursuit — ignore difficult terrain vs marked target

cards.name: Sentence of Doom
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature currently marked by you within 30 feet
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn or until consumed
cards.effect: The next Smite you apply to the marked target before this spell ends treats every Smite damage die as its maximum value instead of rolling. Critical-hit doubling adds another maximized set of the same dice under ordinary critical rules. Sentence of Doom affects only one Smite and does not duplicate its damage packet.

value.spell: Sentence of Doom — smite deals max dice vs marked

cards.name: No Escape
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures marked by you within 60 feet
cards.effect: While affected, a marked creature cannot voluntarily teleport, become invisible or enter extradimensional travel. If it willingly moves out of your Oath aura, opportunity attacks against it have advantage until the end of its next turn. This spell does not prevent ordinary movement, forced movement or planar effects explicitly stronger than the ward.

value.spell: No Escape — marked foes within 60 ft cannot teleport, become invisible, or use extradimensional travel; if they leave your aura, opportunity attacks against them have advantage until end of next turn

cards.name: Final Verdict
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature marked by you within 30 feet and at or below half maximum HP
cards.duration: Instantaneous or empowerment until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: The marked target makes a Constitution save, taking 4 S d8 radiant damage on failure or half on success. On failure it also cannot regain HP until the end of its next turn. If that damage reduces it to 0 HP, use ordinary Downed/death rules; there is no percentage-HP execution. On success your next Smite against it before the end of your next turn uses maximum damage dice. This bounded damage replaces the source draft’s automatic reduction to 0 HP.

value.spell: Final Verdict — marked foe at or below half HP within 30 ft saves or drops to 0 HP; on success, your next smite deals max dice and they cannot regain HP until end of next turn

cards.name: Verdict Absolute
cards.rangeAndTarget: One Judgment Brand target; witnesses in your aura
cards.effect: For 3 rounds, your current Judgment Brand cannot be removed by an ordinary save or concealment effect. Smites against the branded target use maximum Smite dice, and it cannot voluntarily teleport or become invisible. If the branded target reaches 0 HP during the effect, restore your Lay on Hands pool to its normal maximum once, then up to three hostile creatures in your aura that witnessed the defeat make Wisdom saves; on failure they are Frightened until the end of their next turn. The Lay on Hands refill requires a meaningful nonsummoned hostile defeated in a real encounter; staged or willing sacrifices do not qualify.

originalObjects.value: Verdict Absolute — once per day, your Judgment Brand cannot be resisted: marked foes suffer max-dice smites, cannot teleport or become invisible, and if reduced to 0 HP you restore your full Lay on Hands pool; unmarked foes who witness the execution must save or become frightened until end of next turn.

cards.name: Death Touch — Malicious Execution
cards.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
cards.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; rider once per turn
cards.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal necrotic damage equal to the declared Lay on Hands points. If the target was already at or below half maximum HP, it makes a Constitution save; on failure add S d6 necrotic damage. This rider never automatically executes or bypasses normal death rules.

originalObjects.value: Execute chance on wounded targets

cards.name: Fearbrand Aura
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen allies in your Oath aura
cards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
cards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
cards.effect: Selected allies take -1 on morale checks and saving throws against Frightened while in the aura. This is the source's corrosive Malice aura and intentionally burdens nearby allies; it does not force them to flee or change allegiance.

originalObjects.value: Fearbrand — allies near you suffer morale penalties

cards.name: Fearbrand
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
cards.duration: Damage instantaneous; Frightened until end of next turn
cards.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it takes 2 S d6 psychic damage and is Frightened until the end of its next turn; on success it takes half damage and is not Frightened. A target already below half maximum HP takes one additional d6 psychic damage. This creates no execution effect.

originalObjects.value: Fearbrand — increased damage to wounded; spread fear

cards.name: Dominion Smite
cards.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack
cards.duration: Truth rider until end of target's next turn
cards.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
cards.effect: Choose radiant or psychic; the entire Smite packet uses that type. After damage, the target makes a Charisma save. On failure it cannot knowingly speak a false statement until the end of its next turn, though it may remain silent, refuse to answer or speak evasively. If it knowingly lied while inside your Aura of Authority earlier this encounter, it also takes -1 on saving throws until the end of its next turn.

originalObjects.value: Radiant or psychic — bonus damage; compels truth on failed save; liars in aura suffer −1 saves until end of next turn

conductClauses: Uphold legitimate law and order, but do not call convenience or cruelty a lawful charge
Speak truth when acting as arbiter, and hear the whole matter before you command another
Do not use authority for personal gain; a decree that serves only its speaker has already failed the oath

cards.name: Aura of Authority
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
cards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
cards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
cards.effect: A selected ally gains +1 on Intimidation checks. When a selected hostile creature knowingly attempts to speak a direct falsehood, it makes a Charisma save. On failure the lie catches in its voice and listeners know supernatural pressure disrupted the statement, but the creature is never forced to answer truthfully and may instead stop speaking.

originalObjects.value: Aura of Authority — allies +1 to Intimidation; enemies must save to lie within aura

cards.name: Heaven's Decree
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within 30 feet that can hear you
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: State one simple command: Approach, Retreat, Drop, Kneel, Halt or Release. The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure, at the start of its next turn it chooses either follow the command in the safest reasonable way using no more than movement and one object interaction, or refuse and take 3 S d6 psychic damage. Player-controlled targets always make this choice themselves. The command cannot require self-harm, confession, belief change or permanent allegiance.

originalObjects.value: Heaven's Decree — command obey or suffer psychic damage (1/rest)

cards.name: Compelled Truth
cards.effect: While in the zone, when a creature knowingly attempts a direct spoken falsehood, it makes a Charisma save. On failure it cannot complete that false statement but may remain silent or speak truthfully. If the Director had already identified that creature before the spell as having knowingly violated a sworn agreement established in play, the failed save also deals S d6 psychic damage once per round. This spell never forces a creature to speak.

value.spell: Compelled Truth — 10-ft zone where deception fails; oath-breakers take psychic damage on failed Charisma save

cards.name: Binding Word
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within 30 feet that can hear you
cards.effect: The target makes a Charisma save. On failure it is Restrained until the end of its next turn. At the end of that turn it repeats the save; failure extends Restrained one final round, success ends it. A creature unable to hear the Word is unaffected.

value.spell: Binding Word — restrain on failed Charisma save

cards.name: Law's Weight
cards.effect: A hostile creature is considered a source-qualified law breaker only if it knowingly lied while inside your Aura of Authority earlier this encounter. When such a creature enters or starts its turn in the zone, it makes a Charisma save. On failure its Speed is halved, AC is reduced by 2 and it cannot benefit from Dash or Haste-like extra movement until the start of its next turn. It saves again each turn while affected.

value.spell: Law's Weight — 20-ft zone for 3 rounds; lawbreakers (those who lied in your aura this combat) save or half speed, −2 AC, and cannot benefit from haste or dash until zone ends

cards.name: Decree of Submission
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature within 30 feet that can hear you
cards.effect: Choose Sub mission or Dread. The target makes a Wisdom save; a source-qualified law breaker has disadvantage on the initial save. Sub mission: on failure the target is Charmed by you and you state one simple command from Approach, Retreat, Drop, Kneel, Halt or Release. On its first affected turn it follows that command in the safest reasonable way using no more than movement and one ordinary Action, then repeats the save at turn end. Dread: on failure it is Frightened of you and cannot willingly approach you, repeating the save at the end of each turn. Either mode ends on a successful repeat save. Player-controlled targets retain target choice, may never be commanded to self-harm, and cannot be forced to change beliefs or permanent allegiance. Spending that Action uses the hard-denial allowance. On later turns the effect only imposes Charmed and, on a failed repeat save, no Reactions and half Speed until the next turn; it cannot command another Action.

value.spell: Decree of Submission — 30-ft command; target save or charmed (obey one command) or frightened (cannot approach you) for 1 minute; oath-breakers have disadvantage

cards.name: Sovereign Mandate
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen allies or enemies in your Oath aura
cards.effect: Selected allies have advantage on saving throws against Charm, Fear and compulsion. When a selected enemy first enters the aura or is selected there on your turn, it makes a Wisdom save. On failure, until the end of its next turn it cannot knowingly speak a direct falsehood in your presence, but may refuse to speak. Re-selecting the same enemy on later turns grants another save rather than extending automatically.

value.spell: Sovereign Mandate — allies in aura gain advantage on saves vs charm, fear, and compulsion for 1 minute; enemies who fail a Wis save when entering aura cannot lie in your presence until end of next turn

cards.name: Sovereign's Ascendance
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures in your Oath aura
cards.effect: Choose up to 3 creatures in your aura. An allied target gains advantage on Charisma saves and +2 on Intimidation checks for 3 rounds. A hostile target immediately receives Heaven's Decree without an initial save and must choose whether to obey its bounded command or take the normal psychic backlash. Until the end of its next turn it also cannot knowingly speak a direct falsehood in your presence. This Final does not permit self-harm commands, forced belief, confession or permanent allegiance.

originalObjects.value: Sovereign's Ascendance — once per day, Heaven's Decree affects all enemies in aura without save; allies gain advantage on Charisma saves and +2 to Intimidation for 3 rounds, and enemies who fail cannot lie or disobey a direct command until end of next turn.

cards.name: Death Touch — Tyrant's Grasp
cards.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
cards.duration: Control rider until end of target's next turn
cards.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; rider once per turn
cards.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal necrotic damage equal to the declared points. The target then makes a Wisdom save. On failure choose Approach, Retreat, Drop or Kneel; on its next turn it must either perform that bounded instruction using no more than its movement and one object interaction, or refuse and lose its Reaction until turn end. The rider cannot cause self-harm, belief change or permanent control.

originalObjects.value: Will control on touch

cards.name: Obey Aura
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura
cards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
cards.frequency: Choose targets and one prohibition at start of your turn
cards.effect: State one simple prohibition for the selected enemies: do not approach me, do not leave this area, do not attack a named visible creature, or do not speak. The first time each selected enemy knowingly violates the prohibition before your next turn, it takes S psychic damage. The aura never prevents the action and cannot punish the same creature more than once per round.

originalObjects.value: Obey — psychic damage for disobedience within aura

cards.name: Obey
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies in your Oath aura that can hear you
cards.duration: Until end of each target's next turn
cards.effect: State one bounded command: Approach, Retreat, Drop, Kneel, Halt or Release. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it chooses at the start of its next turn either obey the command in the safest reasonable way using no more than movement and one ordinary Action, or refuse and take 2 S d6 psychic damage. Player-controlled targets make that choice themselves. No command can require self-harm, confession, belief change or permanent allegiance.

originalObjects.value: Obey — mass command with psychic backlash

cards.name: Purifying Smite
cards.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack
cards.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
cards.effect: Choose fire or radiant when you Smite; the entire Smite packet uses that type. If the target is undead or a fiend, after damage choose one temporary magical buff, disease-like enhancement, curse-derived boon or other removable beneficial condition currently affecting it. If the effect is within ordinary dispelling scope, end it. This purge never removes innate creature traits, class engines or permanent statistics.

originalObjects.value: Fire and radiant — bonus damage; purges one condition from undead/fiend on hit

conductClauses: Purify corruption and undeath where found, but name the thing being purged before you raise the flame
Do not burn the innocent in zeal; fire that cannot distinguish harm from shelter has forsaken this oath
Accept that fire renews as well as destroys, and remain to protect what must grow after the burning

cards.name: Aura of Purification
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
cards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
cards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
cards.effect: A selected living ally has advantage on disease saving throws. A selected hostile undead creature takes S radiant damage at the start of its turn while still in the aura. This pulse occurs at most once per creature per round and cannot generate resource or damage-reflection loops.

originalObjects.value: Aura of Purification — allies resist disease; undead in aura take radiant damage at start of turn

cards.name: Holy Inferno
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures in your Oath aura
cards.effect: Choose each target as hostile or allied. A hostile target makes a Dexterity save, taking S d8 fire plus S d8 radiant damage on failure or half on success. An allied target takes no damage and may end one of Poisoned, Diseased if magically curable, or a finite curse that ordinary cleansing could remove. oathCatalog.theme: Mercy is a shelter kept open in the worst hour: protection, healing, and the preservation of life before vengeance can make another wound.
conductClauses: Never refuse a genuine plea for healing or protection when the oath can answer it
Set the saving of life before the taking of it, even when anger makes the latter easier
Offer defeated foes the mercy their surrender can bear, without abandoning those still in danger
Do not raise lethal force against the innocent or defenseless; strength was given to stand between them and harm

oathCatalog.theme: Vengeance is judgment carried through the long road: fury disciplined into pursuit, execution held to a sworn account, and no refuge promised to the unrepentant.
conductClauses: Pursue sworn enemies until justice is served or they surrender; let no convenience excuse a broken charge
Do not abandon allies to feed a private vendetta, for judgment that leaves the faithful behind is only rage
Accept the surrender of those who genuinely repent, and hold them to the peace they have asked for

oathCatalog.theme: Authority held as a public burden: law spoken plainly, judgment bound to truth, and rulership measured by the safety it keeps
conductClauses: Uphold legitimate law and order, but do not call convenience or cruelty a lawful charge
Speak truth when acting as arbiter, and hear the whole matter before you command another
Do not use authority for personal gain; a decree that serves only its speaker has already failed the oath

oathCatalog.theme: A fire kept for cleansing rather than hunger: zeal tempered by restraint, corruption confronted, and renewal guarded after the ash
conductClauses: Purify corruption and undeath where found, but name the thing being purged before you raise the flame
Do not burn the innocent in zeal; fire that cannot distinguish harm from shelter has forsaken this oath
Accept that fire renews as well as destroys, and remain to protect what must grow after the burning

oathCatalog.theme: The living memory of the old places: nature guarded as a covenant, ancient power answered with humility, and renewal left possible for those who follow
conductClauses: Protect ancient places and living memory, especially where no living voice remains to speak for them
Do not destroy what cannot be restored; power does not excuse a wound made for haste
Honor pacts with fey and primal spirits, and do not mistake an old promise for permission to command

oathCatalog.theme: Humility, watchful restraint, and strength held in quiet
conductClauses: Speak when words serve the oath; let silence bear the rest
Do not claim glory for the work entrusted to you
Hear the whole matter before you judge it

oathCatalog.theme: A vigil of iron: martyrdom, warding, and the burden freely borne for another
conductClauses: Stand between the helpless and harm, even when the cost is yours to bear
Keep every ward entrusted to you; do not abandon the bound when danger closes
Take suffering freely to spare another, but never make a chain of their sacrifice

oathCatalog.theme: Sorrow, remembrance, and the duty of passage

Do not make sport of grief or profane a place of remembrance

oathCatalog.theme: Liberty, the breaking of unjust bonds, and freedom guarded against a new tyranny
conductClauses: Break the bonds of the unjustly imprisoned, and do not turn liberation into license to abandon them
Resist every tyrant, including the one who would rule in freedom's name
Guard the newly freed from exploitation, for an open door is not yet a safe road
