# Creature companions: life, commands and identity

**REVIEWED / reference-VALIDATED: 121 targeted checks and 2,800 Ranger conversion states.** This overlay discusses 100 exact passages from Druid, Mage, Mirrorsage, Ranger and Wizard, supported by five frozen common paragraphs. It closes no full class, form, temporary-HP system or complete runtime by itself. [Source register](CREATURE_LIFECYCLE_SOURCE_BINDINGS.md), [source integrity](CREATURE_LIFECYCLE_SOURCE_VALIDATION.json), [behavior checks](CREATURE_LIFECYCLE_PLAYTEST_VALIDATION.json).

The original class cards and frozen class guide remain intact. The notebook's first classification, boundary reconciliation and event-model decisions are preserved in the audit folder. Where the historical first reply differs from the later boundary replies, the later explicit resolution controls. In particular, Auto-Raise is automatic, its new minion cannot act at all in the creation round, and Mirrorsage Charm was not in the older 219-source control closure.

## At the table

Keep one companion command and one offensive companion allowance per owner per numbered round, including multiclass companions and devices. A normal command costs your Bonus Action. A damaging companion action, or Mage/Wizard control action, spends the offensive allowance. A pure support command spends only the command. The earlier device ledger's internal field named `damage` now represents this shared offensive allowance; its public behavior remains compatible with existing device checks.

Issue ordinary commands during your regular turn. The selected companion moves and performs its command immediately after your whole turn, in an attached phase. It receives no extra independent turn. If it or its target becomes ineligible before execution, the command fails without refund. Your later incapacity or removal alone does not cancel an issued command; actual concentration/source ending can. Uncommanded companions can move defensively and Dodge, subject to their conditions; this grants no generic Reaction or autonomous attack/control.

Use the owner's original regular companion markers for recharge and previous/next-turn references. Extra turns, initiative changes and removal do not restart those markers. The attached phase's event-resolution checkpoint is distinct: it refreshes no Reaction, recharge, Action, death save or regular duration clock.

## Different kinds of creature life

| Creature | HP and 0 HP | Return and identity |
|---|---|---|
| Finite standard summons, Druid swarms, Mage Familiar, Mirror Beasts | HP-only bounded layer; at 0 disappear/end | No corpse, resource or free resummon; a new summon pays its actual source costs |
| Ranger Beast | HP-only; **NEW** immediate death at 0, no Wound checks, Stable or death saves | Actual animal and ordinary surviving corpse; death ends bond. No automatic resurrection or rebond |
| Mage Lich elite | Destroyed bound asset at 0; no usable corpse/resources | Same unique asset remains owned. Soulbound or actual completed LR can return it |
| Wizard standard undead | Destroyed at 0; consumed body never returns as new fuel | Ends on destruction, dismissal or owner's next completed LR, including Auto-Raised minions |
| Wizard elite | Supplied profile/cap only in this package | Binding/acquisition and return procedure are still missing; no create/bind/return API |
| Reflective Companion | Original creature's HP and life rules | Temporary control relation; no copied body, reset, new statistics or duplicate turn |
| Druid form | Same character's HP/life rules | Full forms and Buffer Reserve remain a separate open interface |

Companion healing restores legal normal HP only. It does not reset identity, duration, recharge, actions, source uses, effects or command budgets. Ranger's “heal normally” supplies no Hit Dice pool or automatic rest healing. The HP-only layer is specific to this reviewed companion chassis, not generic law for all animals/NPCs. Existing animal conditions, disease, poison, explicit injuries and timed effects survive bonding.

## Stats and ownership

**NEW:** finite created creatures snapshot base HP and AC at creation. Attacks, saves, class DC and S use the current values of the original source owner at resolution. Keep source owner, current controller, source class and creation source separate. A temporary controller does not donate their class levels, PB or attack bonus. The implementation rejects stats belonging to another owner/class; it provides no unrestricted transfer/rebinding operation.

Standard profile: AC 12 + floor(PB/2), HP 2L, Speed 30, owner PB for saves, one class attack for S d6 with printed melee/ranged mode. Druid swarm uses current PB+WIS, piercing and its printed tiny-gap movement. Familiar snapshots AC 12+PB and HP 5+Mage level+M; its current source-owner Mage attack fires a 30-foot Elemental Dart for S d4. Focus is fixed at creation: Lightning adds Fly30, Fire/Cold their matching resistance. Changing Focus neither morphs nor refills it. One Familiar; replacement ends the prior one.

Ranger maximum is **NEW dynamic** max(1, 2×current Ranger level + actual WIS modifier), not M. Current PB updates its standard AC/saves/attack. Persistent Mage elite maxima use current source-owner Mage level; fixed AC stays fixed. Capacity growth never heals; shrink clamps HP without damage. Wizard elite profiles use the same names with their own original Wizard source statistics if a future legitimate binding source establishes them.

The [reviewed maximum-HP ledger](MAXIMUM_HP_PLAYTEST.md) supplies source-qualified modifiers. Conjuration is the original creating Wizard level snapshot and requires actual Wizard spell creation. Corpse Harvest qualifies only with actual access; Auto-Raise is not a spell and grants no new Conjuration snapshot. Flesh Ascendant is the explicit dynamic eligible-current-controller exception; engine and card are one effect, not two bonuses. Creation starts at full final legal maximum unless the actual source enters damaged; later added capacity never fills HP. Callers update dynamic modifier records from their real sources.

## Ranger's persistent bond

Use the printed one-hour ritual, touch, 4 RP and one long-rest use. The animal must already be willing/tamed, noncorrupted, INT below7 and CR no greater than Ranger level. The helper does not invent finding/taming rules. Keep one chosen movement mode, capped40 feet, and the original keen-sense identity; no monster stat block, boss powers or free special actions. Exact keen-sense selection definitions remain an evidence gap.

**NEW initial conversion:** for a living animal, new HP = max(1, floor(new maximum × old current HP / old maximum)). A wounded animal stays proportionally wounded. This is profile conversion, not healing or damage. A living bound Beast cannot be rebonded to refill HP. On death, ordinary legal resurrection may restore the same animal under its own source, but it remains unbonded. A new full ritual also requires an actual completed long rest after bond death.

Physical body identity is separate from current corpse eligibility. Keep one record whose state is living, corpse, consumed or removed. Accepting an already-resolved, independently legal resurrection immediately marks that same body living and unavailable as a corpse, before any rebond. Corpse Gateway cannot use it while living. A later genuine death with a surviving body makes that same record a corpse again; no fragment/new body identity is generated. A consumed/removed body requires explicit reconstruction by the actual resurrection source before it can return. The notification helper grants no resurrection ability, payment exemption or automatic bond. Rebond uses the actual post-resurrection HP ratio and preserves death history; it cannot claim a healthier ratio. Full global corpse decay/cleanup remains open.

## Mage Lich assets and elite commands

An actual successful Lich transformation unlocks Boneflayer, Dreadblade and Wraithbound. Readiness and informed retirement-risk consent are source guards; this lifecycle helper does not perform that irreversible ritual. **NEW shared identity:** across Mage/Wizard, one owner can have at most one of each named elite and three total. Destroyed assets still occupy those identities. Any future external Wizard binding must validate against the same asset register; the current helper offers only its profile schema.

| Elite | Profile | Source-native actions/riders |
|---|---|---|
| Boneflayer | AC14, HP12+2L, Speed30; ranged60, 2d6+S necrotic | Fear Pulse replaces attack, enemies10 feet WIS or Frightened through target-next-end, recharge3. Grave Miasma replaces attack: radius10 point30 until next owner-start, enemies entry/start1d6 once, recharge3 |
| Dreadblade | AC16, HP16+3L, Speed30; melee5, 1d8+S necrotic | Concentrating hit target immediately saves with disadvantage; natural20 applies printed −1 attack Weakened until target-next-end. Advantage against forced movement |
| Wraithbound | AC14, HP10+2L, Fly40/hover; melee5, 1d8+S necrotic | Natural20 CON or Stunned until target-next-end under shared character→target hard-denial guard |

Rolls, chosen enemy geometry, recharge payments, exact condition applications and canonical hard-guard sharing remain caller/source responsibilities. This helper returns attack profiles and bounded lifecycle/command transitions; it does not silently execute every on-hit effect.

**NEW Miasma integration:** creation spends one offensive command. Its native finite entry/start damage needs no second command and does not spend next round's offense. Retain no-resource/no-recursion flags. An old zone tick is not a new companion turn or attack.

Wraithbound loses source invisibility on attack **or control**. It can regain it at the end of its next original regular companion marker if the predicate remains satisfied. A current-marker end cannot immediately restore it. The actual offense event must notify its marker state. Core Invisible still does not grant unknown location, sight through walls or automatic target legality.

Soulbound requires the destroyed own bound elite within30 or its inert token, legal empty space30, Action, 5 RP and one LR use. Return the same asset/instance at **NEW source-specific** max(1, floor(current maximum/2)), plus S+M temp HP for60 seconds under normal temp-HP rules. Do not copy machine reconstruction permissions. Preserve spent uses, recharge clocks, command history and still-applicable effects. Completed LR returns those same Mage assets at full current HP unless an actual campaign consequence prevents it. Rest-use/recharge resets come only from the canonical rest system; a return itself grants none. Natural effect expiries must still be processed.

## Wizard corpses, standard minions and Auto-Raise

Corpse Harvest costs Action+4 RP, recharge2, legal corpse/space30. Humanoids qualify; actual Infernal Pact also permits Fiends. Skeleton: AC14, HP6+2WizardL, Speed30, ranged30 1d6+S necrotic. Zombie: AC12, HP10+3L, Speed20, melee5 1d8+S. Goblin Thrall: AC13, HP8+2L, Speed30, melee5 1d6+S; requires a goblinoid body even with Pact.

All standard minions and reserved Auto-Raise slots share a cap of3. Manually dismiss an existing standard minion before attempting a fourth; failed creation spends nothing and does not consume the body. Harvest consumes the original body. Summoned, raised, copied, illusory or fragmented remains provide no new corpse fuel. Corpse Gateway uses a legal body without consuming it; it does not grant raising permission. Global corpse decay/removal rules remain open.

Ghoul Lash uses the shared BA command and2 RP with another controlled undead within5 at issuance. Its chosen standard minion makes **two independently rolled normal attacks**, not numerical damage copies. Each can miss/hit/crit. This remains one command and one offensive allowance, with at most one Auto-Raise opportunity.

**NEW queue integration, preserving the printed automatic trigger:** the first qualifying personal killing blow by a standard minion automatically reserves the body, one capacity slot and the killer's mechanical minion type. It spends the owner's round opportunity immediately. Ineligible kills do not spend it; a qualifying trigger cannot voluntarily be declined. Body reservation does not prevent another legal consumer from taking the body first. A destroyed/expired killer does not cancel an already-created reservation.

Resolve after immediate death responses and already-due end damage/saves, before ordinary expiry cleanup, in stable application order. An ordinary attached attack has its own `attachedCompanionEnd` queue checkpoint after its consequences, in the same numbered round. That checkpoint is not a second regular turn marker. Kills before the checkpoint closes may reserve. A later administrative kill cannot reopen it, roll forward or leave an orphan queue; its unused opportunity remains unused unless another independently valid trigger occurs before another legally open checkpoint.

At resolution, still-eligible body, legal space and cap permit creation; otherwise release the reservation but retain the spent round use. Auto-Raise costs no Action or RP. The newborn cannot voluntarily move, Dodge, support, attack, control or react in its creation numbered round. Passive defenses/conditions/expiry continue. It ends at destruction, dismissal or next completed owner LR. Owner unconsciousness/death alone does not invent a new ending.

## Mirror Beast, Reflective Companion and Echo origin

One Mirror Beast **or** Reflective Companion slot. Summoning a Beast replaces the old body/control relation administratively; it never kills the real previously controlled target. Mirrorcall adds M max/current HP at creation and5 Speed. Advanced Mirrorcall spends BA once/encounter for appearance plus its printed swim/climb adjustment; Mirror Shift spends BA+1 RP/recharge2 for swim30 or climb30. Neither heals, restores uses, releases Echoes, grants flight/anatomy, or refreshes duration. Corrupted and Shattered on-hit dice/splash retain their exact once-round source qualifiers; full damage-event execution remains in the later copy/trigger work. Luminant Bond supplies only its printed local WIS-save/Invisible advantage interface, with ordinary cover/targeting intact.

Ordinary Beast: Action2 RP, empty space15, one minute, recharge3. Radiant/Shattered: Action4 RP, empty space15, concentration3 of the owner's regular turns, recharge4. Actual scheduler supplies the precise three-turn endpoint. Radiant chooses attack, BA+1 RP heal S d4 to living ally5, or paid Echo origin, once per numbered round. The healing pipeline resolves rolls/modifiers before the lifecycle HP gain; no invented resurrection.

**NEW Mirror-origin exception:** your Echo resolves immediately as your Action during your own turn, including a real extra own turn if real Action, BA and unused shared caps exist. An extra Action alone supplies no BA. Preflight active Beast, actual record, release cap, owner target perception, current Beast range/LOE, Action, BA and RP before any spend. The Beast grants no remote sensory feed or free preceding movement. You own record consumption, Dissonance, Refrain, concentration and spell damage. BA command is spent; offensive companion allowance is not. A later independently legal Gadget Sync may spend it. No second BA command or second local Beast option appears.

Charm Creature remains Action3 RP, one LR use, WIS save, target INT<=6 within30, concentration at most3 rounds, no PC/boss without actual encounter permission. Repeat save at target's actual turn end and when harmed by your side. No suicide, compelled beliefs or permanent allegiance. Original identity/HP/conditions/effects/stat provenance/initiative remain unchanged. A successful save spends cast costs but does not replace an existing Beast. Source-specific save/Charm immunity and permitted target/route checks remain caller responsibilities.

**NEW hard-denial reconciliation:** initial Charm applies the actual Charmed relation and slot without spending hard denial. While active, one BA may queue at most one pending forced ordinary Action, never unique powers; ordinary attack damage capped S d6. Queue to the next future regular target Action: this round if upcoming, next round if already passed. Pay BA in issue round; reserve offensive allowance in the resolution round. The target receives no duplicate attached turn.

At the designated Action slot, revalidate Charm, capability, legal order and the shared character→target→encounter hard guard. Valid execution replaces that Action and spends both hard guard and offense. If Charm ends, target becomes incapable, legality fails or another same-character feature spends hard denial, cancel and release unused offense; retain BA/costs and do not spend an additional hard denial. Call the pending-order revalidation when those facts change, not only at the future turn. Once a forced Action has occurred, this effect permits no further forced attack, Dodge, movement or replacement Action. Actual Charmed restrictions/repeat saves remain; no new fallback is invented.

## Druid summon dependencies

Base Swarm Summoning: Action, one SR use, space30, concentration10 minutes; independent of form. Carrion Rat King: Action, actual Form Surge, once per shift, one standard swarm for at most60 seconds and only while its parent form remains; replacement affects its old form swarm, not independent Base Swarm. Broodmother: on entry actual Form Surge creates two adjacent bodies with one combined commanded attack; end at the earlier of60 seconds or parent form end. Form change ends those children, not unrelated paid summons.

Master of Vermin substitutes the paid summoning spell's profile while preserving its actual count, duration and concentration. No extra casts, creatures or command budget. Its independently paid spell creatures do not inherit a form-ending dependency solely from that substitution. Full forms, reserve arithmetic, per-form special actions and temporary-HP effects remain open.

## Reference boundaries and next work

The helper requires certified source access, legal target/space/range/LOE/perception, ordinary condition capability, real paid Form Surge, canonical action wallets/use scopes, actual concentration/clock endpoints and actual completed rest events. These are explicit inputs, not guessed by creature names. A fresh wallet/ledger per ability is invalid integration. Recharge/frequency keys represent already validated canonical scopes; caller must not mint a new key to bypass them.

Open: Wizard elite binding/return, real Beast natural rest and keen-sense details, global corpse cleanup, broader companion families, full forms/tempHP, complete damage/copy/proc execution, ordinary spell and content catalogs, human balance and complete runtime. Classification of incidental source passages is not closure of their complete effects.

[Final notebook disposition](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CREATURE_LIFECYCLE_FINAL_CLOSURE.md) approves only the selected100+5 source roles and interfaces described here. Incidental full-form/tempHP effects remain deferred.


## Dominate Beast integration

The [reviewed rank-three Enchantment supplement](ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md) adds the source-qualified Dominate Beast bridge for actual Beast companions. It redirects only an existing owner-attached execution opportunity, preserves original profile/source-owner stats, reuses a same-companion/same-phase pending reservation where applicable, and occupies the original owner's structural command/offense caps without charging that owner's Bonus Action. It grants no independent companion turn, duplicate phase or new resource pool. The prior lifecycle text above remains intact; the new bridge is an authored manuscript addition whose stateful runtime integration remains open.

# Damage sharing, prevention and interception

**REVIEWED / reference-VALIDATED —39 exact source passages and two supporting Tinker engine passages.** [Final notebook review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_REDIRECTION_FINAL_CLOSURE.md) closes this bounded damage-sharing interface with94 checks and186 conservation states. It does not establish every item/spell defense, companion lifecycle, all-source attack chain or numerical balance. Original source cards remain unchanged.

Read the [source register](REDIRECTION_SOURCE_BINDINGS.md), [source checks](REDIRECTION_SOURCE_VALIDATION.json), [reference checks](REDIRECTION_PLAYTEST_VALIDATION.json), [first notebook proposal](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_REDIRECTION_FIRST_REVIEW_PARTIAL.md) and [complete corrections](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_REDIRECTION_BOUNDARIES.md). Later corrections supersede the retained first proposal.

## Resolve the kind of protection first

Guardian Pulse changes the target of an attack before comparing its original roll with AC. The Guardian becomes the actual hit/miss and on-hit-rider target. One attack can be retargeted once. Multiple offers are chosen by the original intended target; only the selected Guardian spends its Reaction/use. After the incoming attack fully resolves, a surviving, eligible Guardian may make the printed counterattack against an attacker in reach whether the original attack hit or missed. This free attack cannot grant another free attack or Action. Retargeting does not spend the later damage-transfer opportunity.

Bloodbond and Veinlock Tether divide the finalized raw damage before either recipient's mitigation. Attack/save success, save-halving and critical dice have already determined that amount. Bloodbond transfers one quarter, rounded down; Veinlock instead chooses up to S+M. Each recipient applies its own eligible defenses once to its own share.

Other supplied damage transfers divide damage after the original target's defenses and legal pure prevention, before temporary HP. Their transferred portions keep damage type and skip another DR/resistance/immunity/prevention stage. Temporary HP, applicable HP floors, would-die replacements, Wounds, concentration and ordinary life consequences still apply. “Unmitigated damage” does not mean “death cannot be prevented.”

Pure prevention removes damage without creating a second recipient. Elemental Absorption adds its resistance during ordinary defenses. Aura of Bonds and Crown reductions use the strongest applicable class flat reduction, then resistance/immunity. Finite/reactive prevention such as Bloom and Ancestral Guardian follows those defenses before post-defense transfer and temporary HP. Verify additional item/spell sources before treating this as universal defense ordering.

Redirecting Palm prevents half the Monk's post-defense damage, rounded down. The Monk keeps the remainder. A second enemy distinct from the triggering melee attacker, within5feet, can receive new force damage equal to the prevented amount, capped at Monk level. That new damage gets its own defenses; it is not a transferred attack or critical hit. With no second enemy, the Monk still receives the reduction.

Direct HP payments from Blood Sacrifice, Flesh-to-RP, Profane Exchange and Channel Life stay outside the damage sequence. They bypass temporary HP, obey their own legal minimum HP and do not create damage/Wound/resource triggers from paying the cost. Healing-recipient substitution and excess-healing conversion also remain distinct operations.

## One transfer operation and exact amounts

A root here means one original recipient's damage packet. A shared area cast has a separate root for each original recipient, under the same cast/roll identity.

One such root accepts one damage-sharing operation across all owners. A pre-mitigation split locks both its retained original portion and transferred portions against later transfer. Burden Shared can divide one operation among up to two other explicitly willing recipients. It does not create two redirection events. No transferred recipient may be the original damage target.

**New stage-precedence integration:** consider pre-mitigation offers before applying defenses, and post-defense offers afterward. Within the same stage, select eligible positive mandatory/automatic protection before optional offers; competing mandatory claims are chosen by the original damage target. A legally chosen Bloodbond/Veinlock operation can therefore preempt later Aegis/Final Stand because that root is already claimed. Do not preview or consume defenses/Bloom to decide a later-stage preference. The helper accepts an already selected legal operation; it does not select Reactions or schedule automatic offers.

Optional transfer requires a positive chosen amount and available damage. Zero transfer cannot spend an optional Reaction/resource/use. A mandatory rounded-zero share does nothing and spends no transfer allowance. An independently legal prevention component can still occur.

| Source | Transferred amount |
|---|---|
| Bloodbond | floor(raw damage/4), fixed |
| Veinlock Tether / Shared Breath / Selfless Guardian | chosen up to S+M |
| Protective Stance / Emergency Protocols | min(S+M, available damage), fixed |
| Life Linked | chosen up to floor(available damage/2) |
| Guardian Tissue | floor(available damage/3), fixed |
| Aegis Incarnate / Martyr's Share | floor(available damage/2), fixed |
| Chainbound Smite | chosen up to max(3, actual CHA modifier) |
| Linked Ward | chosen up to max(2, twice actual CHA modifier) |
| King's Smite protection | chosen up to5 |
| Aura of the Crown | chosen up to M |
| Crown of Embers / Burden Shared | chosen up to level+M |
| Crown Undying | chosen up to remaining level+M round allowance |
| Final Stand | all available damage, subject to shared allowance |

Every amount is capped by the available packet at its source's stage. Fixed fractions/fixed protection cannot voluntarily choose a smaller amount. Original actions, range, willingness, costs, active-state requirements, cadence and source-specific use limits still apply.

## Hit identity and final damage accounting

The original damage target retains its original hit, failed-save, critical and on-hit-rider identity even if all damage is transferred. A rider that requires positive damage must recheck the actual remaining packet. A transferred recipient was not hit by that attack and did not fail its save; it receives no attached poison/control/maiming/knockout rider merely because damage moved.

Accordingly, transferred damage from a critical attack gives an already0HP recipient the ordinary one damage failure, not two critical-hit failures. Concentration still sees the transferred recipient's resolved packet even if temporary HP absorbs all of it.

Use the [reviewed life-state interface](HEALING_DEATH_PLAYTEST.md) after resolving each final recipient. Numeric actual damage is temporary HP absorbed plus actual normal HP lost, excluding overkill and damage prevented by an HP floor. Sum each terminal recipient once. Do not also count the unsplit parent or unrelated counterdamage.

Physical root totals include every recipient. A healing/resource/reflection consumer sums only branches permitted for that consumer and qualifying for its own source's target predicate. For example, a meaningful-hostile-only drain does not automatically count damage transferred onto a friendly protector. Check all applicable flags for a compound trigger, such as a passive healing proc.

## Source-specific restrictions

All transfers prohibit another transfer. All supplied post-defense transfers prohibit another mitigation/prevention stage. Further restrictions differ:

| Source family | Additional restrictions on transferred damage |
|---|---|
| Paladin engine | No reflection or resource generation; does not universally prohibit other retaliation or healing |
| Protective Stance | Also no generic damage-trigger chains |
| Burden Shared | Also no derived healing |
| Oracle Life Linked | No reflection, resource/RC, passive, condition, action or copy generation; no recovery or retaliation |
| Guardian Tissue / Aegis | No BT generation; no invented ban on every other resource |
| Shared Breath | No additional generic trigger prohibition |
| Selfless Guardian / Emergency Protocols | No retaliation chain |
| Bloodbond / Veinlock | Each recipient still has its one defense stage; no additional blanket prohibition |

A no-derived-healing flag does not prevent unrelated later healing of the recipient.

The source's explicit redirection riders remain narrowly available. Unbroken Covenant triggers on the redirection operation, even when Protective Stance prohibits generic damage triggers; use half the final protector actual damage, capped at S+M. These self-absorption riders require damage actually transferred to the redirecting owner, not to another ally under Burden Shared. Linked Ward's own transfer granting temporary HP on reducing the Paladin to0 uses final actual damage, capped at level+M. Final Stand also gives the protected ally temporary HP equal to Paladin level and resistance to all damage through that ally's next turn end; the numeric helper handles only temporary HP, and the caller must create the resistance record. None grants a generic permission to ignore other source restrictions. Temporary HP still uses the larger remaining amount and does not stack.

## Paladin round ledger

Track each Paladin owner's numbered-round events. Ordinarily, one redirection event is available, using exactly one Paladin redirection feature. Final Stand is automatic on the first eligible positive post-defense packet while its allowance remains; the Paladin cannot save it for a later hit. Its “all damage” text does not override the explicit engine ceiling. It may redirect again in a later numbered round if still active before its source-next-start deadline.

Crown Undying can raise the owner's total to two different damage events, with at most one ordinary/non-Crown feature. The additional permission belongs to Crown Undying. A prior ordinary redirection remains recorded if Crown activates later in the same round; only one further Crown event is then possible. Reapplication does not clear history.

The two Crown events may protect the same selected ally. Sum Crown-transferred amounts against level+M per round. Its heal is floor(final Paladin branch actual damage/2) for each event, then capped by the remaining S+M per protected ally that round. Commit that nominal source entitlement before target healing restrictions; blocked or capped healing refunds no event, transfer amount or healing entitlement. The heal cannot heal the Paladin or start another redirection/heal-copy chain.

## Bloom and devices

Bloom Ward is a finite10+Oracle-level prevention pool across packets. Apply its legal prevention after ordinary defenses. Subtract only the prevented amount. The bloom ends on depletion, its1minute expiry, or actual legal removal. Suppression alone does not end it. Ending grants the printed +1 Frightened-save rider through the target's next end. A late clock observation must retain the endpoint calculated from the actual expiry, not create a fresh duration. An unmitigated transferred branch cannot consume this prevention pool.

Emergency Protocols requires an active/conscious drone within its printed range. The transfer occurs after the Tinker's defenses and before temporary HP. The drone receives the bounded transferred amount without mitigation; legally granted temporary HP can absorb it. At0HP the drone is destroyed and receives no organic Wound or death-save procedure.

Tinker engine[2] retains the destroyed drone at0 until its explicit repair/rebuild procedure. Ordinary functional repair cannot reconstruct a destroyed drone or reset ammunition, uses, duration or command budget. This package's device helper only resolves damage/destruction; it does not implement reconstruction or grant a destruction reward. The broader companion/device lifecycle remains open.

## Reference boundary

The helper validates arithmetic, stages, branch identity, replay protection and round entitlements. Callers establish legal sources, target relationships, exact source cadence, action/resource payment, clock endpoints and source-native riders. No helper imports card ownership merely from a string identifier. The source register preserves every exact original procedure alongside the overlay.

Guardian Pulse's new counterattack carries its explicit no-further-free-attack/no-Action limits, without inheriting unrelated incoming healing/resource/reflection restrictions. Palm's force damage has no invented copy/action/resource prohibition; each downstream source determines eligibility. It cannot trigger another Palm because it is not a melee attack.

Validation currently covers94 targeted checks and186 conservation states. Full-game completion, human balance and all-source combat/device execution remain separate unfinished work.

currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText: ## Burning **Preserved Core text:** Take fire damage at end of turn. An action, immersion, or successful Dexterity save ends it. **Effect:** At end of the affected creature's regular turn its generic record offers 1d4 fire damage to unified family arbitration, unless its source specifies another magnitude. Only the winning stack group deals damage. Damage immunity does not by itself remove Burning. **Application:** Applied only by an effect that explicitly inflicts Burning. Record the applying effect's DC; if none exists, use DC 10. **Duration and ending:** Self or adjacent helper may spend one Action to end all active ordinary-extinguishable attached fires on this creature. Full immersion of all burning portions does the same. Explicit protected-source exceptions survive. At each regular target turn end, after due ticks are consumed, each surviving active ongoing-fire record with future damage remaining makes its own binary DEX save against its own source DC or 10. Success ends only that record. An indefinite generic fire counts as having future damage; a finite record with its final tick consumed expires without another save. **Stacking:** Independent records enter unified ongoing-fire family arbitration. One Action/full immersion clears all ordinary-extinguishable records; DEX saves operate per surviving eligible record, not one selected-source save for all fires. **Immunities and specific exceptions:** Fire immunity prevents the damage but does not automatically end Burning unless the source or immunity says so. An effect explicitly immune to Burning blocks application. **Explicit integration decisions:** - NEW: 1d4 fire fallback, source DC or 10, damage then free ending save; Action/immersion can end before damage. - NEW: shared periodic timing and strongest-record precedence; adjacent helper and immersion boundaries. - SUPERSESSION — NEW PROVISIONAL INTEGRATION: The unified Bleeding/ongoing-fire family registry supersedes earlier provisional clauses that selected generic records separately, used ending DC as a damage tie-breaker, cleared all generic Bleeding through one Medicine result, or used one Burning save to clear all generic Burning. # Reputation — Canon Interaction Rules

**Status:** Playable canon

Reputation records how Aethel's institutions respond to the character. It is not a morality score and it is not a hidden multiplier on the laws of magic.

## Scale

Faction standing is stored as `{ [factionId]: score }` on the character save, normally from **−3 (Hated)** through **+3 (Honored)**. Backgrounds and play can set or change starting standing.

## What reputation can change

A faction may change:

- prices, credit, insurance, salvage rights, and expedition sponsorship;
- access to restricted libraries, teachers, rituals, recipes, laboratories, temples, circles, and sanctuaries;
- information quality, contacts, safe houses, legal treatment, hostility, and political support;
- availability of a **named** focus, training feature, consumable, or scene benefit whose rules are written explicitly.

## What reputation does not change automatically

Reputation does **not** silently modify:

- a spell's Resonance Rank;
- base RP cost;
- natural maximum RP;
- Dissonance gained from a cast;
- the Frayed / Discordant / Fractured thresholds;
- a character's moral alignment.

If a guild teaches a cheaper technique or a shrine grants a recovery boon, that is an explicit earned benefit, not proof that the Weave itself favors members of that institution.

## Magic connection

The universal magic rules are in [`RESONANCE_CANON.md`](./RESONANCE_CANON.md). Faction standing can provide **tools for dealing with magic**, but never rewrites the underlying resonance law merely because the character is liked or hated.

## Companion implementation

- `src/data/reputation.js` owns faction definitions and starting standing.
- `character-storage.js` persists the reputation map.
- `resonance-economy.js` retains compatibility helper names for old saves/code, but automatic reputation-to-RP and reputation-to-spell-cost modifiers return **0** under current canon.

This separation is deliberate: institutions matter socially and materially; Resonance/Dissonance remain metaphysical rules.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: 4. Base RP cost
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## 4. Base RP cost

```text
Base RP cost = Resonance Rank × 2
```

Rank 0 cantrips cost **0 RP**.

Only explicit **class or item text** may modify this cost, plus the universal Dissonance surcharge and chosen Overcast options. Moral alignment and faction reputation are never automatic cost modifiers.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Authority, access and cost
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: The selected ordinary identity and its actual classAccess row control school, rank, minimum class level and base RP. Preserve the entire classAccess object, every catalog/Core original, book binding, placeholder, absent/null distinction and additionalRpCost. Enough RP does not grant access or repertoire. An already completed explicit ordinary-spell access exception, such as the actual Druid Circle always-prepared table, retains its real acquisition/rank/preparation gates once its matching payload passes exact review. Record that particular grant and use its actual class progression/cost; do not rewrite ordinary classAccess, infer a new variant from a same-named class power, or approve a pending class feature here. Rank costs remain 0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26 for ranks 0–9, with the actual class engine, discounts, Dissonance surcharge and additional/maintenance costs separately applied. Oracle Revelations remain RC techniques; a same-named class, ancestry or recipe permission is not this ordinary spell. No default upcast or cantrip level scaling is added. Every direction below is authoring authority only; every existing source operational:null and pending status remains untouched until separate exact review.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Actual casting transaction
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Use the selected source Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or longer casting time and actual V/S/F or M/F requirements. V requires the caster's own presently usable voice; recordings are not V. S and a real permitted focus obey the existing hand/access rules. Unpriced M/F permits the actual focus alternative and creates no invented costly/consumed material fee. Explicit physical substrates below are real target/work prerequisites, not inferred M costs. Observable legality is checked before commitment; hidden immunity/type/meaning does not become free diagnosis. At commitment spend the actual action/resources and update actual cast/cadence history before the existing counterspell chain; a countered, missed or resisted committed cast refunds nothing. Concentration begins under the existing rule and can end the old concentration even when the new cast is countered. Long casting uses actual uninterrupted work and governing interruption/Ready rules. No successful spell roll authenticates an asserted object, voice, teacher, corpse or world permission.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Native rolls and damage
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Spell attacks use the actual owner's spell attack modifier versus AC: natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles damage dice of that attack, not flat modifiers or later ticks. Saves are binary total-versus-spell-DC, with no natural-die degree shift. A specified examination is an INT (Investigation) task against the creating caster's snapshotted spell DC: use Core degrees/natural shifts, then collapse Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure unless an entry supplies distinct outcomes. For one simultaneous area effect, snapshot geometry and eligible targets before damage, roll each stated shared damage expression once, then apply each recipient's save and actual type defenses independently. Half damage floors each typed component once at the stated save stage. Follow the existing reduction, immunity/resistance/vulnerability, temporary/form buffer, actual HP loss, Wound, death and concentration pipeline. No descriptive Damage/Healing/Control tag supplies an additional attack, damage, healing or condition.

currentLowRankSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW explicit use where source timing is absent
currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Clocks
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: A bare hostile one-round rider ends at the end of the target's next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn at application; a bare self/ally one-round benefit ends at the start of the caster's next future regular turn. N hostile rounds use the Nth such target end; N buff rounds use the Nth caster start. Outside initiative, those are 6N elapsed seconds. Keep the registered clock through initiative changes using the existing virtual-clock adapter; extra turns do not create expiry/tick opportunities. A NEW duration expressed in minutes/hours below uses an absolute elapsed deadline from completed resolution, including an absolute 60-second deadline for “1 minute”; the one-minute means neither an extra initial tick nor reset when initiative starts. Repeated round damage expressly uses future target regular-end checkpoints and its printed finite count, not one immediate tick plus that count. End-turn ticks/repeat saves precede their scheduled end-turn expiry; start expiry precedes voluntary actions. Suppression pauses eligibility/effect, not deadlines; scheduled suppressed ticks are spent, never queued. Entries that expressly use a named trigger instead of a generic clock keep that trigger.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Multiplicity, effect identity and present state
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. Independent class exceptions retain their exact scopes; this is not a universal strongest-effect rule. NEW default for these previously uncompleted spells: one active instance per caster per ordinary spell ID, unless a row expressly permits more; a successfully resolved replacement ends that caster's prior instance, but an illegal/countered attempt does not replace a nonconcentration instance. Different casters retain separate source records, clocks and restrictions; identical numeric bonuses never add. A current complete record is required for every competing effect. Instantaneous completed consequences are not active-instance stock. An entry explicitly limiting waiting triggers counts only its stated waiting state; its spent playback phase never refills or occupies a waiting slot. Continual Flame explicitly permits separate paid anchors, with only its per-anchor limit; do not impose the default one-caster limit on it. Loss, repair, transfer, suppression or a new database ID cannot renew an already consumed mark, scheduled tick, trigger, command budget or source resource. Removal of one source does not erase another's independent condition. Any change in actual target/custody state is logged; it is not a new casting.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Attack/check marks
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: A row expressly saying attack commitment reserves and spends its mark when the beneficiary commits a legal declared attack, before a roll; cancellation after that commitment and a miss do not refund it, while an illegal declaration that never commits does not spend it. Otherwise “next attack/check” marks spend on the next actual qualifying roll, including a miss/failure; unrelated rolls and passive procedures do not consume them. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. Multiple competing next-roll marks eligible for the same event all spend, though only permitted strongest/advantage effects operate. Suppressed marks do not benefit or consume on an event while suppressed, but their deadline continues. Delivery attacks and later attacks consuming a delivered mark are different events.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Sight, illusions and meaning
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: An image is not an opaque physical barrier, creature, material, light source, safe floor, sound receiver or extra targetable body unless its row expressly creates that thing. Ordinary hearing needs a real acoustic path; sight needs the relevant illumination, range and unobstructed view. Knowing an illusion does not grant sight through a real wall. For visual/audio deceptions below that permit examination, one Action using a currently accessible relevant sense can make the LR-G03 examination; success identifies that cast as illusory for that observer, while failure permits another examination only after genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive witnessed physical contradiction establishes the applicable false part without a roll. An ally's warning allows examination but does not globally switch every observer to knowing. These procedures do not compel belief, pursuit, an attack, trust or a sale. Current Invisible rules remain: invisibility is not automatic Hidden; observers who know location lose only the special invisibility-derived attack advantage/disadvantage, not unrelated concealment. Language samples reproduce what was heard, not meaning or credentials. Preserve LA's six-second aggregate voluntary-speech budget per numbered round and actual component/oath windows. Spell-created sounds are not the caster's later speech, but original recording speech and the caster's V are real speech.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Range, targets and geometry
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Unless a specific row explicitly uses detection without sight, select an actually perceived eligible target or point within the literal Core range and with the existing line of effect. A target can be self within a creature-target range unless the source/row restricts it. “Willing” means current actual consent; an unwilling holder prevents a willing-only object spell without supplying an opposed-roll workaround. Detecting some magic is not necessarily perceiving a creature for targeting it. One target means one physical identity, not every same-named database row. NEW missing cone width is its length at its far end; missing line cross-section is five feet wide and five feet high. All source radii remain radii, not distances added to cast range. Area membership/cover are evaluated from the actual origin at that event; walls are not retroactively removed for a second pass. “Enemies” uses the caster's declared ordinary opposition set, not a supernatural alignment/intent detector. Caster/allies are included in indiscriminate areas. No range is silently replaced by an outside game's value.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Conditions and hard-control guard
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Use actual Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed and Stunned definitions without importing another game. Paralyzed/Incapacitated and other hard Action denial obey the current source-character/target/encounter allowance shared across that owner's effects; only successfully established hard control spends it, once for the effect's full allowed window. A blocked hard portion supplies no invented substitute penalty; independently printed damage, Prone or another separately allowed portion can remain. A spell's repeat save ends only the stated source. Ending laughter, restraint or paralysis does not automatically stand a Prone target. NEW “flee” directions below require actual safe available movement away at the next regular-turn movement opportunity, using existing Speed/cost and leaving Actions to the target; they do not force Dash, expend a Reaction or require deliberate self-harm. If no safe farther legal location exists, no movement is forced and no action is lost. Panicked is explicitly bound only in IL-23, not added as a global condition. Haste's voluntary ending cost is separately addressed in R3-12.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Movement, falls and body continuity
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Ordinary movement spends real movement cost and needs nonzero permitted Speed, legal support, actual space and the appropriate locomotion mode; changing a speed or mode does not reset spent cost. A spell-directed extra movement allowance expressly stated below supplies only that finite allowance. Teleportation relocates rather than traverses, does not itself provoke opportunity attacks and does not generically defeat a source that blocks relocation; no route is inferred through planes. Check destination occupancy, whole body/gear geometry and lawful carry/load. Supplying a point is not permission to materialize inside another body. Unsupported endings, launches and lost flight use the existing FallMarker and finite falling resolution, not a new immediate damage tick. Actual transformations retain original identity, own HP/resources, spent state, origin restrictions and body/equipment priority; no new monster sheet, harvest pool, HP refill, gear duplication or size-based ability increase. Actual equipment can be melded only by the stated form procedure, stays real weight/history and is unavailable while melded.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Summons, corpse assets and commands
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Each row supplies its actual finite body, attack and lifetime rather than importing a monster. Use printed HP/AC before any new fallback. For the NEW profiles below, creating caster's class level/PB/ability at creation fixes any printed-derived maximum; attacks and saves use that same source owner's currently lawful spell attack/PB, not a transferee's or a monster's sheet. Unless stated, saves add owner's PB, ordinary ability/skill checks add 0, normal vision only, no special damage or condition immunity, no independent equipment proficiency or spellcasting. One such spell-created asset per caster per spell ID; the existing total companion/control budget still binds. Creation grants no free attack or movement. A command uses one Bonus Action on the owner's regular turn through actual visible/audible communication within 60 ft; no telepathy is invented. It acts in the attached phase after that whole turn, shares the owner's one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round, and has no independent refresh on extra turns. Uncommanded it can only ordinary Dodge and make defensive movement within speed; no automatic pursuit, work or offense. Loss of the channel means no new command, not free autonomy. A complete task needs its real appendages, capacity, instructions and paid time. At 0 HP, expiry, source dismissal (Action) or concentration end where required, the asset ends; summoned apparatus disappears without loot, corpses, ammunition, harvest or salvage. An actual corpse used as fuel retains its original finite matter/history and the stated terminal consumption; no source can reclassify it as newly obtained material. Keep Ranger's genuinely ordinary animal remains distinct from no-resource summons.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Suppression and trigger ordering
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: An ongoing magical object's target stays the same physical anchor; transfer or repair cannot duplicate/rearm it. Full magical suppression prevents sensing/operation while it lasts and does not queue missed triggers; duration continues. An acoustic silence can block only sound independently of a physically detected trigger. Resolve simultaneous eligible one-shot triggers in creation order then stable cast ID. Consume a triggered use before its payload, even when a later barrier, silence, immunity, cancellation or receiver state prevents useful output. A sound produced by another real spell can be a phonetic trigger if all actual constraints match, but each waiting trigger resolves at most once and cannot recreate itself or another charge. Source death/distance ends a nonconcentration effect only where the source/row says so; it does not refresh it. Suppression does not undo already completed mundane writing, moved matter, healing, damage or superficial preparation. An explicit persistent permanent spell remains a magical effect, not a manufactured item or free rechargeable device.

currentLowRankSharedRules.disposition: NEW spell-specific wrapper family; existing costs/cadence kept
currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Copying, acceleration, delay and proxies
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Quick Cast and Delay Spell are the only new wrapper identities authorized here. None may take itself or any of those four as payload, nor may an already echoed/released payload become a replay source. One payload may receive at most one of these temporal/replay modifications; they do not duplicate Ready or grant an additional Bonus Action, Reaction or full Action. Existing acquired class permissions remain their own exceptions, not automatically folded into this family. Select the actual original casting record, same ordinary source class and native legal access; only that spell's normal Action version with one finite resolution is eligible, excluding long casts, Reactions, Bonus Action spells and ongoing maintenance actions. Repeating a miss or resisted but fully resolved cast permits a fresh legal cast, not copying its damage result; a countered or aborted original is not a replay source. New targets/range/components and current costs/statistics must qualify at the new commitment. No active rider, successful roll, other caster's access, expended item charge or selected resource award is copied for free. Cantrip Echo's row defines one composite ordinary-cast transaction; Echo Cast/Quick Cast/Delay Spell instead have their separately paid arming transactions and later actual payload commitments. Record parent, wrapper, payload, cost, original owner and single-use consumption. No zero-base-cost replay recursively generates resource refunds or unearned casts. A legal fresh payload still resolves its own actual damage and expressly funded healing; this guard prevents copied old awards and recursive new-cast/refund grants, not the payload’s specified new outcome. Resonance Tether changes a legitimate delivery origin only, never the responsible caster or their RP/RC pool.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror intercept only the first actually resolving ordinary spell effect that has exactly their warded creature as its sole direct creature recipient, beneficial or hostile. Area, multitarget, self-only, anchor/object, summoning, channel/ongoing tick and already redirected effects are ineligible. NEW interception/return distinction: a Touch-delivered, healing or willing-recipient spell is eligible for interception when it satisfies the foregoing sole-recipient and scope requirements. The original caster's eligibility to receive the return, including actual consent and creature-type requirements, is tested only after that eligible ward has been spent. An ineligible original caster therefore causes a spent, unsuccessful return and leaves the original recipient, exactly as below. A legal Touch return uses this explicit magical return, not a new physical touch or Action. No rank cap is added; actual protective exceptions can still forbid redirection. After counterspell resolution but before that spell's attack/save/effect, spend the ward once and substitute the original actual caster as recipient only when it is presently a legal recipient under the payload's own type/other eligibility. The original caster remains owner and supplies DC/attack roll and costs; this creates no new casting, resources or second packet. An ineligible original caster causes the spent redirection to fail and the original spell continues against its original warded target, not automatic cancellation. An eligible redirected attack can miss normally; spend is not refunded. The original targeting distance has already been established; the explicit return uses that same causal cast, with return line blocked by an actual barrier defeating the return path, not arbitrary remote range extension. A blocked return likewise leaves the original target. A causal root can be redirected at most once by these two spells; another mirror on the new target neither redirects it again nor consumes its ward. Duplicate wards on the original target arbitrate earliest creation then stable ID; only the selected ward spends. These are NEW finite interpretations of “first/single-target spell,” not permissions for Wizard/Oracle or other reflected-damage features to use this protocol.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Necrotic damage, healing, corpses and restrictions
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Actual damage and healing follow completed Core and feat procedures. No ordinary necrotic spell gains Bleeding, disease, Oracle Decay, a curse, corpse fuel, a soul resource or a healing prohibition by name/tag. A drain's specific permitted funding is stated in its row; an unfunded heal/RP transfer cannot be manufactured from overkill, a reflected packet, an already paid award, target transfer, current permission overriding no-resource origin, or a temporary body. Existing Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch, Lifeleech, Necrotic Affinity, Soul Cage feat and class drains keep their own nonidentical source predicates; the new drain restrictions are not retrospective amendments to them. Actual independently eligible acquired feats can respond once under their completed source rules, never a second time to the resulting heal/resource transfer. A corpse interface uses actual dead identity and retained memory; it does not establish an afterlife, soul custody, truth beyond memory or current thoughts. Preserve actual death/removal clocks, condition and no-resource restrictions through stabilization, question, animation and return. A later paid question cannot retrieve information the old remains never retained; fragments are one donor history, not separate minds.

currentLowRankSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW bounded physical work choices
currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Real matter, preparations and economy
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: A spell moving or reshaping real matter retains the actual predecessor quantity, material, contents, owner, damage and consumed/harvest history. Count retained mass and disposed matter once. It does not change source tier, named ingredient eligibility, equipment grade, formula knowledge, rarity, assigned value, an old recovery claim or an apparatus's paid service/charges. Cosmetic temperature/color/shape does not sterilize food, undo spoilage, neutralize a poison or supply a professional crafting result. Explicit elementary structures allowed below still need real support and dimensions; no unknown material or hidden load-bearing property is authenticated by the spell. A genuine subsequently usable mundane item can enter only its actual existing rules and finite market; no automatic sale price, buyer, XP or crafting-output multiplication. Fulfilled 687/433 recipe and NWX/LA procedures remain controlling.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Concentration and early termination
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Where a row says concentration, it occupies the one actual concentration slot, ends under the completed damage-save/incapacitation rules and can be ended voluntarily under that rule; no new per-round maintenance RP is imposed. A source explicitly printing concentration keeps it even when an independent rider ends sooner. NEW voluntary early termination for a nonconcentration instance authored below requires the original caster's Action and actual perception of its anchor/recipient within that spell's original range; no remote recall or refund. Instant completed consequences cannot be voluntarily reversed. Named permanent Until Dispelled effects have no general voluntary end from this default; use their own source or actual dispel. Invalid physical continued operation removes only what can no longer function; full destruction of a required anchor ends its anchored instance. No repaired anchor is a new instance.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Aliases and unassigned variants
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: Uncontrollable Laughter uses the matching historical Tasha's Hideous Laughter Core metadata only through the explicit IL-18 binding; Resonance Tether analogously uses Mana Tether through UN-13. Preserve both historical names, exact effects and alias records without adding separate ordinary identities. Prestidigitation's two actual school modes are independently specified in IL-06 and selected by the cast's actual access row. Phantasmal Force rank 3, Stone Shape rank 4 and Mislead rank 5 remain preserved unassigned alternative records: no current classAccess row acquires those higher-rank modes, no chooser can buy them by paying more RP, and no new question or ordinary promotion is invented for them. The assigned lower-rank modes receive complete directions. Echo Cast's Core “base RP” is the chosen operational reading of its catalog's broader shorthand. Soul Tap's catalog HP AND Resonance selects the joint operation explicitly. Unravel Spell's “Tier 4” means the generating ordinary spell's rank≤4, not material/equipment/creature tier. All differences stay beside unchanged competing source fields.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Audience and comparison records
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: All 137 selected ordinary identities and 141 original book bindings remain preserved internally; public teaching uses only actual public fields and the resulting operational mode when later exactly reviewed. A source mention does not publish a private dossier, class membership, material source or hidden research metadata. The 54 full selected class comparisons and 114 distinct spell counterparts retain their actual IDs, resource engines, windows and statuses; matching names/words do not merge any of them. Pending feats and spell comparisons stay pending. The eight submitted proposals are separately disposed below as source directions, not adopted by their mere inclusion. No change to the fulfilled language, teaching or recipe authority is required by these ordinary directions.

currentLowRankSharedRules.title: Delivery and deferred receipts
currentLowRankSharedRules.wording: R3-04 Blink is receipt-only: retain its full original and question, current pending operational state and literal setting references; author no plane itinerary, probability, reappearance/body procedure or promotion. Other incidental literal names, including Silent Ones, Heartcell, Matrix, Voice and deep-language terms when present, remain source receipts without interpretation. Local portals/teleports below are explicitly local procedures, not a decision about cosmology. Source authority here does not certify gameplay runtime, human teaching/balance, bestiary/acquisition availability, DD01 or final systemic consistency. Owner's final whole-game flow precedes an authorized GitHub push; verified remote commit precedes careful cosmology review. No deletion/push is authorized.

originalExamples.originalText: AB5-01-A: A caster inside the active sphere commits an otherwise legal rank-five spell, spending10RP and its ordinary cadence. Its payload is suppressed and receives no later delayed resolution on leaving. An already-established remote buff outside the sphere is not canceled merely because its concentrating caster entered it.

AB5-01-B: A body-attached magical buffer has12remaining when the bearer enters. It cannot absorb a new8damage packet inside; leaving within its original lifetime restores the same12remaining, not20and not an8HP refund. Ordinary stone already created by an instantaneous material spell remains real, and two Lesser Antimagic fields do not switch each other on and off indefinitely.

AB5-03-A: The snapshot includes a rank2buff, rank5field and two recipient records from one rank6cast. The first two end automatically. Wizard+8rolls15for23against rank6DC22, so both captured rank6recipient applications end using that one success. An unselected remote recipient remains unless the original source truly binds it to the ended parent.

AB5-03-B: An eligible wall blocks another effect when the purge snapshot is taken. Ending that wall does not add the formerly hidden effect to this cast. A rank6check rolling natural20+0against22 uses the reviewed natural improvement from Failure to Success; no standard-game flat natural20 rule or free protected-effect identification is substituted.

AB5-04-A: A recipient makes the original WIS save against a hostile spell and later that spell's printed WIS ending save. Both gain ordinary advantage while this hour-long ward operates. If a separate source imposes disadvantage, normal cancellation yields one ordinary roll, not multiple advantage dice or a reroll after seeing failure.

AB5-04-B: A spell attack damages the warded creature. The attack receives no automatic disadvantage, and the creature's resulting generic concentration save does not gain Spell Resistance merely because the damage came from a spell. A charge-based item actually casting a save-requiring spell does qualify, regardless of whether it charged the caster RP.

AB5-05-A: An invisible vertical wall blocks an arrow and a directly targeted spell whose path must cross it, though a viewer can see the opponent through ordinary light. The caster cannot bypass the effect barrier simply by choosing a damage-area center beyond it. A real open route around its finite edge remains available.

AB5-05-B: A legal horizontal wall supports a creature until concentration ends, then actual Falling starts at that height. If a portion is suppressed and a body straddles it when suppression ends, local restoration waits for legal clearance; it neither bisects the body nor grants a free push to a tactically chosen square.

AB5-06-A: Wizard9 choosesX2with unmodified base10and no surcharge, paying12RP (32→20) and offering60prevention. A later17damage packet after ordinary defenses consumes17, leaving43and no residual packet. It does not generate17temporaryHP, RP recovery or drain credit.

AB5-06-B: With pre-cast Dissonance10against limit10, base10+X2+surcharge1cost13and still offers60, not65. A received transferred branch explicitly bypassing prevention leaves the pool unchanged. A new40point offer against43remaining loses the strongest-only comparison and does not refresh that old source, despite the new actual payment.

AB5-08-A: In one actual scene the protected character receives a legitimate+1contribution and a−2contribution. The latter is recorded as prevented0; the net unprevented+1uses the ordinary scene/absolute caps. The shield does not force NPCs to forgive the underlying act or erase evidence, and no−2debt appears after24hours.

AB5-08-B: The character gains standing from+1to+2while protected; later genuine negative contributions are still blocked rather than merely allowing a fall back to the original+1. A voluntary transaction requiring payment of1standing cannot obtain its benefit for free. During a genuine suppression interval, a new ordinary penalty may lower standing and is not rolled back when protection resumes.

CJ5-01-A: The pet receives the one legal BA attack command and hits for2d10=12fire. A perceived foe still adjacent at its next regular START fails the aura DEX and takes1d6=5fire. These are the one commanded attack plus the explicitly printed passive aura, not permission for a second companion Action.

CJ5-01-B: A foe crosses the aura three times in one turn. Entry itself deals nothing; only its actual future regular START can attempt the family tick, with one owner/target history for the round. Replacing the pet or granting the foe an extra turn cannot reset that history or turn the pet into free fuel.

CJ5-02-A: The chosen type is cold and the shared5d8roll is23. A failed enemy takes23before defenses; a saved enemy takes11, then actual cold resistance halves that to5. The cast stays cold for both and creates no ice patch or slow condition.

CJ5-02-B: A visible center is20feet from the caster and the sphere extends another20feet beyond it; range and radius are distinct. All perceived qualifying enemies with center line of effect are included, while an unseen presumed enemy is not revealed or selected from hidden allegiance data. There is no finite target-count cap to redistribute after a save.

CJ5-03-A: After failing the original CON save, the target takes no immediate damage. Its next three future regular STARTs roll1d10=6,3,9fire. These total18nominal damage before defenses over exactly three opportunities; no extra first-round packet is added to the printed promise.

CJ5-03-B: The second START occurs while the rider is suppressed and is consumed without a roll/damage. The third remains its original last opportunity. A bucket of water does not remove this non-Burning spell record, and a later successful initial CON save against another cast does not erase the existing application.

CJ5-06-A: An eligible actual rank-five spell has ordinary discountable price10and is committed by a caster inside one or three overlapping Nexuses. Its Nexus price is8in either case; subsequent reviewed Ease can make that7. The actual rank remains5and its normal Dissonance gain remains; no2RP is also recovered into the pool.

CJ5-06-B: A Wizard replacing their own concentration Nexus ends the old concentration at commitment, so cannot rely on that disappearing field to price the new cast at8. A genuinely separate other-owner field still present can qualify. A readied cast paid inside keeps that paid price when released outside, with no second discount or refund.

CJ5-07-A: A genuinely positive-standing faction qualifies at creation. The one champion's commanded attack uses Wizard+8and rolls2d8=11plusPB4for15slashing, with no extra companion attack granted. Its apparent shield and armor are intrinsicAC18, not two free sellable items taken from a distant faction armory.

CJ5-07-B: The caster cannot create one champion from each of three friendly factions to gain three source slots; this spell permits one per owner across all factions. An actual later standing decrease does not duplicate or teleport a real officer into its body. On expiry a genuinely borrowed lantern drops intact, while the manifested weapon leaves no harvestable item or NPC corpse.

currentReviewIssues.title: Historical scope and authority
currentReviewIssues.requiredReview: The eleven historical proposals/22 cases remain unadopted. All16identities/17printed placements now require full operational authorship. Five post-push receipts are historical deferrals, not exclusions. Ordinary Banishment is now accepted/applied under the supplied exact receipt; use its full current procedure only within its explicit scope.

currentReviewIssues.title: Null damage and finite summons
currentReviewIssues.requiredReview: The old shared summon rule ends every body at0HP. Current EPI Null procedures instead retain qualifying finite bodies as Null Disabled0 while their own source persists. Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion need explicit current lifecycle, subsequent Null hit, real healing, independent expiry and real cargo handling. AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01 is scoped to its two profiles; extending that healing predicate to new profiles requires explicit NEW authorship.

currentReviewIssues.title: Damage-root timing
currentReviewIssues.requiredReview: Living Magma delayed ticks need an explicit original damage-root checkpoint and inherited Veil flag; a commanded companion attack uses that body's actual dealer identity. Define whether Greater Fire Pet aura checkpoints constitute separate root creation and reuse only rolls, without copying a different actor's Veil status. Suppression consumes scheduled opportunities without inventing damage roots for nonexistent packets.

currentReviewIssues.title: Nexus, Dampening and final price
currentReviewIssues.requiredReview: Accepted AC4 Dampening applies mandatory+2 after ordinary reductions/waivers/minimum and before final Influence. The old Nexus proposal inserts a new reduction after mandatory extras. Decide an explicit source-coherent order with exact waiver, charge-only real spell, cantrip, protected conversion principal and concentration replacement. Do not silently change accepted Dampening or treat a nonspell class engine as a spell because it costs RP.

currentReviewIssues.title: Conversion and damage prevention
currentReviewIssues.requiredReview: Resonance Barrier must define which paid price components buy the pool, especially Nexus/Ease/Burden/Dampening/surcharge and protectedX. Compare actual Harmonic Bulwark and Resonance Shield. No credit for waived/unpaidRP, no double conversion from copied source, no second mitigation of an unmitigated transfer, no prevented-damage recovery or stale source refresh.

currentReviewIssues.title: Antimagic and existing sources
currentReviewIssues.requiredReview: Define exact local suppression and originating-path claims against current remote-destination spells, real teleports and AC4 ward/anchor sources. A global beam/path must not be invented for every nonprojectile spell. Item/nonspell magical components need actual source classification. Preserve pending geometry, body suppression, genuine nonliving objects and clocks. Ordinary Banishment now has an accepted explicit rule: suppressing that application closes/ends it; do not silently make it resume on leaving antimagic.
