completeCard.name: Nature's Whisper
completeCard.effect:
Gain advantage on one Perception/Survival check to find tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage. It reveals evidence on success, not automatically creatures through total cover, incorporeal beings or thoughts.

NEW NWQ-01 classification: this exact card is a magical nonspell class technique, not an ordinary spell, class spell, cantrip, Echo release or Matrix cast. Preserve spellRank:null and the historical originalText; no rank, school, spell component block, repertoire, spellcasting credential or class engine is inferred from its name, its historical minor-spell wording or its 1 RP cost.

NEW NWQ-02 activation: no verbal, somatic, focus, material, command-word or audible channel is required by the technique itself. You must be conscious, capable of the required Action, legitimately entitled to this exact activation, ready on its own recharge ledger, and able to perceive and have line of effect to the selected actual natural terrain within 15 feet. Silence, occupied hands or lack of a casting focus alone do not prohibit it. Actual suppression or a prohibition whose operative scope covers this magical technique still applies. The later investigation keeps its own senses, hands, tools, access and task requirements. A permitted borrowed activation separately requires Versatile Mastery's actual donor preparation, consent and perceived/understood signal; the technique supplies no communication channel.

KEEP shared technique strain: pay 1 actual RP from your own existing lawful personal pool, not a donor pool or newly granted pool. No ordinary spell-rank price, spell strain surcharge, automatic spell Dissonance, Refrain update, remembered-spell-name change, Fracture ranked-cast prohibition or rank-based trauma is applied by this activation. It does not clear, advance, consume or vent an ordinary spell-cadence record. Do not invent a casting ability or recompute a strain Limit for it. A later Perception or Survival check uses your own current applicable task ability and actual proficiency or replacing Expertise, ordinarily Wisdom, not a donor modifier or automatic borrowed skill proficiency. There is no activation attack or saving-throw DC. Its legal commitment is a magical-ability-use event: it prevents idle-turn Dissonance recovery on the actor's regular turn containing that commitment, including when the paid activation is interrupted. An illegal uncommitted declaration is not such an event. Merely retaining the rider or applying it to a later ordinary task is not another activation. Extra turns and off-turn releases create no additional recovery tick and cannot rewrite a completed tick. Actual separately acquired hooks operate only on their exact triggers; this is not a Bard Performance or an ordinary Ranger spell cast, and it grants no donor Track Target, Hit Chain, stabilization, Crescendo or Echo engine.

NEW NWQ-04 commitment and area: before payment, declare this source, actor and one fixed investigation area consisting only of the actual natural terrain within 15 feet of the actor's commitment position that is then perceivable and has line of effect. Record that area and position; the area does not follow the actor and no moving aura or remote sensor is created. Actual hidden clues need not already be known or present to make an otherwise lawful investigation site eligible. Commit the legal Action and 1 RP together, set the actor's same-card Recharge counter to 3, and, for borrowing, spend the single Versatile Mastery use at that same commitment. Record donor provenance without spending any donor resource. A rejected precommit declaration spends none of these costs. Resolve the activation within that same action after only genuinely applicable source-defined interruptions; there is no automatic Counterspell window, opposed cast roll or concentration test. Ordinary Counterspell and rank-limited spell dispels do not acquire this nonspell target. A separately sourced interrupt or suppression must actually cover it; ordinary damage alone does not add a concentration requirement. If the actor cannot finish the activation or its fixed terrain is no longer legally in range, perceivable and reachable by line of effect at resolution, the paid activation fails without a new area or refund. Borrowing's donor condition is tested at actual activation commitment, not imposed as a new continuing tether after receipt of the signal.

NEW NWQ-04 rider and check: a surviving activation gives this actor one unused rider from actual resolution until resolution time plus 60 elapsed seconds; the exact deadline is not renewed by travel, turns, initiative changes, donor departure or the borrowed permission ending. No concentration is required. At most one unused Nature's Whisper rider belongs to that actor across native and borrowed uses; a new successful resolution replaces an older unused rider, not stacks or banks checks. A failed or interrupted new activation does not itself replace an older otherwise valid rider. Before any dice or outcome are supplied, voluntarily bind the rider to one separately lawful and paid Perception or Survival check about tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage in the original fixed area. The relevant terrain/evidence must still be natural, within 15 feet of the actor and accessible to the task's actual senses and line of effect; no total-cover, thoughts, incorporeal-detection or automatic-revelation exception is supplied. Consume the rider at that check's outcome commitment before rolling or determining its result, even if other advantage already exists, disadvantage cancels it, the legal check fails, or a genuine interruption then prevents its result. An invalid check declaration does not consume the rider or grant a free roll. A paid longer task whose check reaches adjudication at or after the deadline receives no rider. Use ordinary task resolution and advantage cancellation; no passive-score adjustment, extra degree effect, free check, new retry or second bonus is granted. Reveal only real evidence supported by the actual successful task and observer rules; unknown data is not proof of absence. Failure does not reveal otherwise hidden facts. Expired, consumed or ended riders cannot be reclaimed by repeating a request.

KEEP generic nonspell Ready: this Action-time technique may be readied through the current Ready procedure. Ready setup spends its Action and records one perceivable trigger; it does not activate Nature's Whisper, pay its RP/feat use, start its Recharge, start its minute, update spell history or create held-spell concentration. On a legal release before Ready expires, spend the required permitted Reaction and perform the actual activation commitment instead of another Action; recheck its own entitlement, recharge, personal RP, terrain and, for borrowing, the prepared donor/signal conditions at that release. An invalid or declined trigger spends no release resource and may await another valid trigger within the same Ready window. Unreleased, replaced or expired Ready loses its setup Action but not an unspent Nature/feat cost. A legally released then interrupted activation retains all committed costs and Recharge. Native and borrowed copies use the actor's same source-ID recharge history; borrowing does not refresh it or the donor's history. Recharge 3 ticks once at each subsequent owner regular-turn start, or once per six elapsed seconds outside initiative without double counting; extra Actions and extra turns do not tick it. A recharge becoming ready grants no new borrowed feat use.

issues.title: Wizard Dispel Magic is a distinct class spell
issues.requiredReview: Wizard class Dispel is Action3RP/60ft/Recharge2/rank3, automatic through3 and INT+PB against10+rank above3. Do not replace this with the proposed Greater Dispel10+2rank procedure or ordinary same-name payload. Sigil Authority explicitly names Counterspell and Dispel Magic checks; do not silently extend its+1 to Greater Dispel solely because both end spells.

issues.title: Nature's Whisper current classification
issues.requiredReview: The old AC5 Ranger envelope predates accepted NWQ. Current Nature's Whisper is magical NONSPELL, spellRank:null, Action1RP/Recharge3, no ordinary spell components/counter window/rank cadence, and has exact suppression and Ready rules. Lesser Antimagic may interact only through a genuinely applicable magical-technique scope; Greater Dispel needs an actual nonspell dispel interface. Nexus/Dampening do not apply merely because it costs1RP.

issues.title: Intrinsic Oracle condition protection
issues.requiredReview: Oracle's Burden expressly prevents generic remove/suspend and requires a feature naming the Oracle Curse. Do not let broad magic language suppress the entire Curse. Manifestation prevents normally voluntary Curse suppression for its3rounds; Tongues and Consumed retain their own expressly named suppression permissions and limits. Decide specific effects from the actual cards, not a blanket class erasure.

issues.title: Spell-save defenses remain distinct
issues.requiredReview: Shaman Spell Resistance already grants advantage against actual spells; the ordinary rank5ward cannot stack another advantage. Thief Arcane Resistance grants+2spell saves, not damage resistance. Druid Nature's Ward immunity covers Charmed/Frightened from fey/elementals plus its printed poison/disease scope, not every ability of those types or every planar removal.

issues.title: Mage price and penetration scope
issues.requiredReview: Arcane Bypass ignores actual printed damage-type resistance for one declared damaging Mage spell, not immunity, antimagic, walls or endpoint blockers. Spell Efficiency needs prior real Focus-eligible cast and next differently named same-current-element eligible spell, min1, with actual exclusions. Use that predicate before the new Nexus/Dampening/Influence stages; no automatic eligibility for every Conjuration spell.

issues.title: Limited theft and suppression are not universal dispels
issues.requiredReview: Preserve each trigger, save, rank cap and selected payload. Arcane Theft only temporary rank1–3buffs and printed AC/Speed/one resistance; it cannot take rank5Spell Resistance, prevention pools, summons or resources. Shattershot distinguishes shield equipmentAC from one visible rank1–3magical defense. Spell Disruptor affects observed temporary magical+AC maximum2; Resonance Barrier is not+AC merely because named shield/barrier.

issues.title: Device abilities are not antimagic by title
issues.requiredReview: Overload Suppression targets construct/device and applies its next-Reaction/attack-disadvantage/Stunned failure-by5 clauses, with shared hard-control guard. Malfunction Field imposes disadvantage on the first qualifying spell attack, once/round total; it leaves save-based areas unchanged and explicitly creates no antimagic zone.

issues.title: Paladin aura and word do not share one suppression scope
issues.requiredReview: The aura uses a target-start CHA save and one Director-selected temporary beneficial non-innate magical effect, never immunities/class engines/permanent traits/attunement. The Blasphemous Word uses an Action2RP, CON and damage plus one temporary beneficial spell or regeneration effect. Keep these predicates distinct in ward/summon suppression examples.

issues.title: Release and transfer apply only their printed components
issues.requiredReview: Liberating Smite/Break Bonds operate on their actual Grappled/Restrained predicates and source release permissions, not generic Planar Binding service or Banishment. Crownshatter transfers temporary+1/+2numerical AC/attack/save bonuses only; it cannot move Spell Resistance advantage, Resonance Barrier prevention, immunity, resources or a class engine.

issues.title: Protected books and radiant conversions
issues.requiredReview: Spell Preservation protects against permanent destruction/erasure but explicitly permits suppression; a field does not destroy or duplicate the book. Cosmic Equilibrium converts actual eligible excess healing/radiant damage under two once/round pools which cannot trigger each other. Fire aura damage and prevented Barrier damage do not become qualifying Cleric radiant damage or actual damage dealt.

additionalExamples.title: Wizard class and ordinary dispels
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: Use a real rank7 ongoing source. Class Dispel DC17 with INT4+PB4 and die10 totals18: success. Proposed Greater Dispel DC24 with the same modifiers and die15 totals23: failure unless its own reviewed rule changes. Record Action/RP/recharge separately and do not automatically add Sigil Authority to Greater Dispel.

additionalExamples.title: Nature's Whisper in a field
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: Actual Ranger with personalRP5 uses lawful Nature's Whisper inside Nexus plus Dampening: it remains a nonspell technique with its own1RP/recharge rules. Separately apply eligible antimagic suppression to the same technique without granting ordinary Counterspell or a guessed spell rank.

additionalExamples.title: Oracle exact protection
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: Oracle2+ with Burden and selected Tongues enters Lesser Antimagic while Curse Manifestation is active. Decide only source-permitted specific suppression; no generic removal of intrinsic Curse or its protected drawbacks.

additionalExamples.title: Different save defenses
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: A Shaman Bloodcaller with its actual passive receives ordinary Spell Resistance: one advantage only. Separately a Thief with Arcane Resistance receives the ward: apply one advantage plus its actual+2spell-save modifier under existing bonus rules; generic concentration saves do not acquire spell-save provenance.

additionalExamples.title: Theft and prevention
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: A Thief attempts Arcane Theft against rank5Spell Resistance, then Spell Disruptor against a Resonance Barrier prevention pool. Both fail the respective rank/payload predicate; neither becomes an AC bonus from a name.

additionalExamples.title: Tinker versus save area
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: A caster under a real Malfunction Field uses proposed Massive Elemental Blast, which resolves via target DEX saves. No spell attack exists for the device's disadvantage to affect.

additionalExamples.title: Paladin release versus service
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: A target is subject to Planar Binding service but is neither Grappled nor Restrained. Break Bonds and Liberating Smite do not automatically end that unrelated binding record. A separately sourced actual restraint uses its own release branch.

additionalExamples.title: Aura and word suppression
additionalExamples.requiredResolution: Use actual Inferno Paladin cards69and70 against a recipient with temporary Spell Resistance and a distinct intrinsic immunity. Respect each save/timing/eligibility and never suppress the immunity via the aura.

completeAuthoredCard.procedure:
Keep both actual placements separate. Conjuration rank 4, base 7 RP, range 60 feet: NEW Action, V/S/F creates a fixed 15-foot-radius sphere at a perceived point with line of effect, with concentration up to one minute. Snapshot each creature’s defined effective axes when it first occupies the area with line of effect to the center, including eligible occupants at creation. While eligible inside, those axes use Alignment Lock’s proposed prevention and underlying-history rules. No save or entry bar applies. Leaving removes the constraint immediately; reentry reuses that application’s first snapshot. Store priority when the application first qualifies on that creature/axis. Exit or suppression makes it inactive for priority selection without changing the original timestamp on resumption. Abjuration rank 7, base 17 RP, range 120 feet, currently Cleric: NEW Action, V/S/F targets one perceived creature with line of effect for a CHA save; a willing target can elect failure. Failure applies the effective-axis lock for seven elapsed days without concentration. Preserve cannot act against it as a bounded conduct restriction: only deliberate conduct explicitly incompatible with the locked record under an already established source predicate can be vetoed. A player chooses another legal action without spending the rejected choice’s costs; no beliefs, self-harm, confession, allegiance or new moral standard is compelled. Without an established incompatibility predicate, the clause has no invented test. A veto that would leave no legal ordinary Action or deny the whole turn additionally requires and spends the shared hard-denial allowance; after it is spent, such a whole-Action/turn veto cannot recur that encounter. The axis lock and independently legal narrower restriction continue. This NEW limiting interpretation is a proposal beside the broader original, not recovered doctrine. Neither placement grants the other’s mode, rank, price or class access.

CURRENT INTERFACE — NEW scoped exception `AC4-ALIGN-01` for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor versus reviewed Alignment Purge/Suggestion. A Lock/Anchor application freezes only the effective defined axis value it actually snapshots; it does not delete, prevent creation of, pause, refund, or rewrite an underlying Alignment Suggestion, Alignment Purge, or independent lawful alignment record. For effective-alignment reads on a locked axis, evaluate the ordinary underlying history and reviewed Suggestion/Purge interaction (including AP-AS-01) first, then apply the active Lock/Anchor snapshot last. Thus a Purge or Suggestion cast after a lock can establish its own live record and pay/keep its own costs and clock, but cannot change the locked effective axis while that lock remains active. When a new Suggestion computes its target baseline, exclude prior Suggestion overlays and Purge overlays as AP-AS-01 already requires, and additionally exclude AC4 Lock/Anchor overlays on the target so the lock cannot become a ratchet staircase. A Purge on the Suggestion caster still affects that caster's own effective orientation normally. If Lock/Anchor is applied while Purge or Suggestion is already effective, it snapshots the currently effective defined value; later ending/suppression of the lower overlay does not alter that snapshot. When Lock/Anchor ends or is inactive because a zone was exited/suppressed, the then-live lower lawful result becomes effective immediately with its original deadline/history; no old snapshot is restored and no missed application replays. Undefined axes are never fabricated.

historicalWorkedCases: The Cleric placement remains rank 7 and base 17 RP. A Druid’s rank-4 zone does not lower that price or grant its own seven-day single-target mode.
A Director cannot invent a moral requirement forcing a player to attack an ally. No established incompatibility predicate means no conduct veto.

completeSharedRules.castingEngine: Use SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md exactly: legal action/components/target/repertoire first; class-specific rank/cost; pre-cast Dissonance; commit RP/materials/concentration; apply Dissonance/Refrain/cast-begin hooks; resolve interruption; then effect. Failed/countered/saved casts refund nothing.
completeSharedRules.timing:
One-minute concentration effects use the source's normal ten future caster regular-start markers in initiative or 60 elapsed seconds outside unless this card states a different exact clock. Ten minutes = 100 future caster regular-start markers or 600 elapsed seconds. Alignment Lock uses 24 elapsed hours; rank-7 Alignment Anchor uses seven elapsed days; Bind Element uses two future target regular ends / 12 elapsed seconds outside initiative. Preserve virtual/absolute deadlines through initiative changes, absence and suppression.
SPELL SHIELD EXACT CLOCK — Because Spell Shield is nonconcentration, its own one-minute deadline is explicit: in initiative, application records the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application, excluding any start already in progress or past. Outside initiative, deadline = application timestamp + 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve that fixed virtual/absolute deadline across initiative entry/exit, reorder, extra turns, absence, caster death and suppression. Caster death alone does not end Spell Shield.
completeSharedRules.null: Creation-time Null root identity remains governed by accepted EPI-08–14. Pure transfer/redirection preserves the root flag. New reflected/retaliatory damage only uses a new root when an exact effect says it creates new damage. Finite summons reduced to 0 by qualifying Null damage use the accepted Disabled branch while independent expiry/concentration/replacement remains real.
completeSharedRules.faction: Use standing-v1 separately from membership and invocation permission. Faction Seal's reviewed invocation-permission procedure is the permission reference where invoked. Positive standing never creates membership or permission.
completeSharedRules.alignment: Reviewed Alignment Purge AP-AS-01 remains exactly source-specific. AC4-ALIGN-01 is an additional NEW scoped exception only for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor; it creates no universal alignment priority engine.
completeSharedRules.banishment: Banishment is not one of these fifteen. The earlier pre-push sequencing hold is historical. Its exact source receipt is preserved and it remains the next separate procedure-authoring obligation using current planes/souls sources.
completeSharedRules.summonTargeting: NEW scoped AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01: solely for the two authored AC4 temporary profiles Summon Water Pet and Faction Envoy, while their finite body exists they count as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This is a mechanical targeting classification only; it establishes no natural origin, biology, soul, corpse, loot, undead/construct taxonomy or cosmological identity. Null Disabled 0 remains the same existing body and may receive an otherwise legal heal; an ended/expired/dismissed body is no longer a target. Resonance Beacon uses active-creature identity rather than biological 'living' status: an enrolled creature must still be able to spend its own Action and RP.

operationalCandidate.completeProcedure:
KEEP Action/V/S/F/base 17 RP, one perceived creature within 120 feet and line of effect, and a Wisdom save negating the effect. NEW choose a temporary True Neutral effective-alignment overlay, not absence of alignment, general predicate suppression or a new moral classification. On a failed binary save and absent an actual applicable immunity, establish concentration for at most 60 elapsed seconds from resolution. Ordinary natural 1/20 do not shift the save. Charmed-only immunity does not stop a spell that imposes no Charmed condition; a genuine broader or alignment-alteration immunity keeps its actual scope. No repeat application/ending save or daily immunity is invented.

NEW explicit undefined-record boundary: this overlay requires both real defined canonical mechanical axes; a genuinely unaligned/no-record creature or a record with an undefined axis is not converted into fabricated Neutral data. Hidden target alignment need not be known by the caster: the ordinary perceived-creature cast commits and resolves its save without a free alignment preflight; missing/undefined qualification creates no overlay and no diagnostic alignment disclosure/refund. An already True Neutral creature with both defined axes can still receive the overlay after a failed save; it can cover later independent changes while live. The lawful underlying record is never overwritten.

Use Neutral/Neutral as effective alignment for rules whose actual predicate queries current effective canonical alignment, including genuine source-qualified alignment damage/detection/item/spell requirements. Rules requiring underlying/permanent identity, actual conduct, earned lineage, acquisition snapshots or independently recorded tags continue to require those facts. There is no new feat/class/spell/item acquisition, loss, healing, RP refill, oathbreak, atonement waiver, forced belief, loyalty, command, Charm or hard-control grant. A live power rechecking effective alignment may cease/resume only under its own dependency rule; a completed independent effect is not generically undone or recast. The underlying source and used allowances survive.

NEW named exception AP-AS-01 to reviewed Alignment Suggestion, not a claim that the old card already excluded Purge: while an actual unsuppressed Purge operates, evaluate its two Neutral values after Suggestion's live fixed changed-axis values, regardless of their cast order. Purge does not delete Suggestion, stop its concentration, extend its own source deadline or alter its source rank. When casting a new Suggestion on this recipient, compute the target baseline with every previous Suggestion overlay AND every Purge overlay on that target excluded, retaining all other actually authorized underlying changes and independent effects. Snapshot the Suggestion caster's own current effective orientation normally, including a genuine Purge on the caster if present. Compute the existing one-step shifts; only genuinely changed defined axes gain fixed Suggestion values. Its no-changed-axis/no-new-replacement rule remains. Thus Purge cannot become a target-side staircase, yet a Purged caster really has Neutral/Neutral for the existing caster-side snapshot.

Independent changes remain below the overlays with their real timestamps; ending Purge exposes the current live Suggestion/underlying result, not a restored old snapshot. Ending Suggestion while Purge remains exposes only what Purge still covers. Suppression of Purge temporarily exposes the other currently lawful result while the original deadline continues; no replay, refund or new application results on resumption. One Purge-family application per target across casters: a new failed-save eligible application replaces the prior record and its unused duration, not two stacked shifts. A saved-against/countered/no-eligible-record application does not itself replace another valid record; ordinary cast-start concentration displacement is separate and is never reversed. Expiry, dispel, caster death/incapacity or loss of required concentration ends this application. An unnamed future alignment effect still needs its own actual interaction; this one named exception creates no universal priority taxonomy and interprets no cosmology.

completeSharedRules.information:
KEEP source-authorized hidden but established world facts as readable information. An authoritative Director-established fact does not need a pre-existing software log or a caster-known document; conversely, a source file, nonempty story label or fixture is not proof of an actual campaign fact. The spell's scope authorizes disclosure, not invention of an otherwise undefined history, actor, faction or operation. Missing data is not zero, Neutral, nonmembership, absence of a trap or proof of an empty past. Preserve exact fact source, version, time precision and audience separately from the current query.

Read every unprotected fact the individual spell promises; do not reduce all activities/history to one favored record or an arbitrary sample. A specific protection applies only to the information, subject, generating school/rank and time scope it actually covers. Protection of one person does not conceal independent institutional/environmental facts, and protected personal facts cannot be relabeled institution/effect history to evade the protection. Supply independently meaningful readable fields. Indeterminate does not identify the hidden reason, number of withheld records or protection. If existence itself is protected, disclose no placeholder, ID gap, total or count derived from that protected existence. Claim No qualifying fact only where absence itself is established and readable; otherwise do not certify completeness beyond the readable facts. An explicitly permitted masking effect retains its own false/altered-result rule; do not override it with a generic truthful-result assertion.

Equivalent paid inquiries under materially unchanged facts, authority and applicable protections give consistent overlapping information across casters/rephrasing. Genuine new events, changed protections or new established evidence can change later paid answers. Knowledge itself supplies no skill success, disarm, control, consent, authority, spell acquisition or free communication. KEEP the reviewed observer-specific location rule: a revealed actual location ends Hidden for that observer and removes Invisible's own attack modifiers for that observer; it does not end Invisible or grant sight. Independent darkness, blindness, smoke and other actual modifiers remain. Communicated information requires a real channel and grants only what was actually communicated. Public teaching/procedure projection never publishes the internal fact/protection/donor dossiers or private membership merely because the rule can query them.
completeSharedRules.timeAndIdentity: KEEP exact event/cast/application identities and source-specific budgets. NEW DI7 sustained durations explicitly specified as 60 elapsed seconds begin at effect resolution, use an absolute phase-0 endpoint, and never reset on extra turns, initiative changes, absence, scene changes or transfer of a token. At that endpoint the effect is unavailable for a new event. Vision Quest's normal completion is its expressly defined completion-and-answer event, not an interruption; same-time competing events use existing timestamp/phase/application-sequence order. Existing counterpart durations, especially Alignment Suggestion's preserved marker rule, are unchanged. Suppression and restoration never replay missed notices or refund spent uses; each exact DI7 procedure states its own continuation or termination. Source death, incapacity, concentration and real suppression are distinct: no universal death-ending rule is imported into an independently attached nonconcentration ward. Keep one concentration slot except an independently acquired, actually paid source-specific exception. Hard denial, damage roots, prevention/transfer stages, real providers and material histories remain the existing rules, not a copy-created replacement engine.
completeSharedRules.examples: All examples are authored conditional adjudications, not actual campaign receipts, full spell-runtime tests or human balance evidence. Unless expressly changed, use an actually entitled single-class Wizard 13, INT +4, PB 5, actual spell DC 17 before separately applicable bonuses, maximum/current RP 48/48, a legal prepared spell, working arcane focus/S hand and audible V. Ordinary Limit is 11. The 17-RP quotations assume pre-cast Dissonance below 11 and no actual price modifiers. A first distinct prepared matrix may waive only its own base strain; its actual encounter history must be specified. A Fate Echo nested copy is the NEW copied-spell route, not another prepared matrix. Explicit example state is a conditional premise, not proof that an arbitrary character has those features, resources, targets or world facts.
completeSharedRules.deferredBoundary: DI7-02 Greater Planar Summons retains two extraplanar allies, CR8 each, Action/120ft/concentration up to1minute/base17RP and every original access row. No operational ally profile, origin, plane, consent, arrival, return or cosmological interpretation is supplied before authorized push and verified remote.
completeSharedRules.shamanCastingInterface:
DI7-SHAMAN-VENT-01 — Shaman vent checkpoint. Evaluate the Shaman’s once-per-round ordinary-spell totem vent at casting-sequence step 5, after step 4 has committed the cast and established any required concentration, ending incompatible prior concentration. Use the caster’s actual position, the actual ownership and active state of the totem aura, this cast’s qualifying ordinary Shaman spell route, and that Shaman’s existing once-per-round use history at this checkpoint. Do not retain a pre-commit aura snapshot.

The first qualifying ordinary spell cast while inside at least one of that Shaman’s own still-active totem auras automatically occupies the round’s opportunity and generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0. This remains the first qualifying cast even when its generated Dissonance was already 0; it does not remove accumulated Dissonance or preserve the opportunity for a later spell. An earlier cast outside an own active aura, or through an excluded route, does not occupy this opportunity.

Establishing incompatible concentration at step 4 ends the shared totem burden and its auras before this determination. That cast therefore receives no totem vent and does not occupy the first-inside opportunity. A later counter, failed result, aura restoration or movement does not replay the checkpoint, refund an occupied opportunity or restore displaced concentration. Multiple own overlapping totems provide only one reduction and share the Shaman’s one round opportunity; another Shaman’s aura does not qualify.

An ordinary Fate Echo outer cast may qualify independently. Its fate-echo-copy child is not an ordinary learned Shaman spell and neither receives nor occupies this ordinary-spell-only vent. A concentration-requiring child ends incompatible totems at its own commitment, without undoing the outer cast’s earlier valid vent. A readied outer cast must account for its actual held-spell concentration; a nonconcentration payload does not exempt its Ready hold from concentration displacement. Release supplies no second outer casting or vent checkpoint.

The vent grants no RP reduction, does not revise already committed RP, and cannot bypass pre-commit casting restrictions. Fate’s required forecast and later child revalidation still use the actual chronological strain and resource state under their existing rules. The existing source-governed round boundary remains unchanged.

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect. No requirement that its alignment be known; hidden canonical axes are resolved after paid casting.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to1minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; an already-passed start never counts. Outside initiative, expires after 60 elapsed seconds. Retain the original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and planar travel; moving between timing modes does not reset it.
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new overlay. Failure: snapshot your actual current alignment orientation. For each axis defined both for you and for the target, compute one step toward your snapshotted value along Lawful–Neutral–Chaotic and Good–Neutral–Evil. Compute the target baseline without any previous Alignment Suggestion overlay on that target and, under the explicitly NEW DI7 AP-AS-01 exception, without any Alignment Purge overlay on that target. Under the NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01 exception, also exclude all Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor overlays on this target when computing this baseline. Retain all other independent actual alignment effects/records. This target-only exclusion does not change the caster-orientation snapshot: an actual Purge on the caster still supplies Neutral/Neutral, subject to that caster's own active AC4 Lock/Anchor snapshot for the final effective read. An unsuppressed Purge on the target covers the resulting live Suggestion values until Purge ends or is suppressed; an eligible active Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor snapshot applies last under AC4-ALIGN-01, without deleting, pausing or refreshing these lower records. An already matching or undefined axis gains no changed-value overlay. If at least one axis changes, replace the prior same-spell overlay with the new recorded axis values/deadline. A failed-save cast that changes no defined axis creates no new overlay and does not itself replace a valid older one; mandatory concentration transitions remain independent.
operational.effect: The changed values are the target’s actual effective canonical alignment for rules that query those axes during the overlay, including real alignment-gated spells/items. Example: baseline Chaotic Evil targeted by a Lawful Good caster becomes Neutral Neutral; one such overlay never jumps two steps. Its values remain fixed until expiry/removal/replacement and do not recompute every time another underlying record changes. Unchanged/unoverlaid axes follow their actual underlying records. An independent effect such as Corrupted can change underlying alignment while this spell persists; that change remains and is exposed when the applicable overlay ends. One Alignment Suggestion overlay per target across casters; recasting cannot use its old overlay as a staircase for another same-spell step. NEW scoped AC4-ALIGN-01: effective-alignment reads evaluate this live Suggestion overlay and the reviewed AP-AS-01 Purge interaction first, then apply the eligible active Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor snapshot last. Lock/Anchor ending or inactivity exposes the then-live lower result with its original history/deadline; no ended overlay is restored. This adds no general alignment priority system.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: The spell grants no automatic knowledge of either character’s axes, including whether a value changed. Actual information protections still govern observations. It never compels matching behavior, belief, confession, loyalty, PvP, personality or oathbreaking; conduct clauses still judge actual conduct. Ending removes only this overlay, without restoring an old alignment snapshot, deleting independent changes or reviving a replaced overlay. Caster orientation is fixed at application, not tracked through later caster changes. Ward tag creates no ward. More specific alignment-changing effects retain their actual interaction rules; this card does not invent a general priority engine for every unrelated overlay. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,M/F as focus, WIS, concentration minute and actual push toward caster alignment. NEW: temporary canonical one-step overlay on both eligible axes. Exact-review proposals: compute without previous same-spell overlay to prevent recast ratcheting, overlay only genuinely changed axes, fixed values, and no new application when no defined axis changes; independent base changes survive ending.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending

operationalCandidate.targets: Two seen, line-of-effect, unoccupied endpoint apertures, each within 30 ft and no more than 30 ft apart.
operationalCandidate.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute or one permitted transit, whichever occurs first.
operationalCandidate.resolution: Automatic local paired doorway; voluntary transit consumes actual movement.
operationalCandidate.effect: NEW two vertical 5-ft-high by 3-ft-wide apertures placed against actually open supported spaces. One willing Small/Medium creature with lawfully carried cargo, combined weight at most 500 lb and actual aperture fit, may step through in either direction by spending 5 ft of permitted movement; then both apertures close. Transit requires available destination support/space and does not enlarge cargo, lift an unwilling passenger or reset movement spent. Occupied/blocked endpoints prevent crossing, not crush or displacement.
operationalCandidate.limitations: No separate sight/attack/spell line through the door, unattended mass flow, projectiles, fluids, unlimited travelers or free transport of remote contents. No cross-plane operation is supplied by the Planar tag. Lost concentration/suppression prevents transit; it never queues a body halfway through. Treat transit atomically at the physical commitment; actual support loss afterward uses normal falling.
operationalCandidate.costProcedure: Use the actual acquired class grant and its preserved classAccess row for rank, minimum class level, school and base RP. Apply that class’s completed casting engine, current repeat history, discounts, Dissonance surcharge and this identity’s additionalRpCost; use LR-G01, LR-G02 and the explicit payload/wrapper exceptions in this card. Oracle RC is separate. Sufficient resources do not grant acquisition. Pay committed costs even on a miss, successful resistance or counter. There is no generic upcast or level scaling.

operationPrerequisites: Actual legal access/repertoire, current source and target state, components, range/line, time and resources under the stated finite procedure; these are use-time facts, not missing source-conference questions.

authoredBoundary.kind: Authored expectation, not executed runtime or campaign authentication
authoredBoundary.wording: A 450-lb eligible traveler and cargo fitting both openings can cross once for 5 ft movement. A 600-lb load cannot be split after declaration into free serial portal traffic.

completeAuthoredCard.newDecisionNotice: Every concrete target bound, resistance, unsupported metadata replacement, mode, action/clock/lifecycle detail and numerical default not printed in the preserved original is NEW source-authoring direction, never a claim that it was printed. Explicit retained clauses and LR-G KEEP rules are not rewritten.

reviewEvidence.approvalScope: Complete authored tabletop procedure; no complete runtime adapter or human balance claim.

completeSharedRules.title: Authority, access and cost
completeSharedRules.wording: The selected ordinary identity and its actual classAccess row control school, rank, minimum class level and base RP. Preserve the entire classAccess object, every catalog/Core original, book binding, placeholder, absent/null distinction and additionalRpCost. Enough RP does not grant access or repertoire. An already completed explicit ordinary-spell access exception, such as the actual Druid Circle always-prepared table, retains its real acquisition/rank/preparation gates once its matching payload passes exact review. Record that particular grant and use its actual class progression/cost; do not rewrite ordinary classAccess, infer a new variant from a same-named class power, or approve a pending class feature here. Rank costs remain 0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26 for ranks 0–9, with the actual class engine, discounts, Dissonance surcharge and additional/maintenance costs separately applied. Oracle Revelations remain RC techniques; a same-named class, ancestry or recipe permission is not this ordinary spell. No default upcast or cantrip level scaling is added. Every direction below is authoring authority only; every existing source operational:null and pending status remains untouched until separate exact review.

completeSharedRules.title: Actual casting transaction
completeSharedRules.wording: Use the selected source Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or longer casting time and actual V/S/F or M/F requirements. V requires the caster's own presently usable voice; recordings are not V. S and a real permitted focus obey the existing hand/access rules. Unpriced M/F permits the actual focus alternative and creates no invented costly/consumed material fee. Explicit physical substrates below are real target/work prerequisites, not inferred M costs. Observable legality is checked before commitment; hidden immunity/type/meaning does not become free diagnosis. At commitment spend the actual action/resources and update actual cast/cadence history before the existing counterspell chain; a countered, missed or resisted committed cast refunds nothing. Concentration begins under the existing rule and can end the old concentration even when the new cast is countered. Long casting uses actual uninterrupted work and governing interruption/Ready rules. No successful spell roll authenticates an asserted object, voice, teacher, corpse or world permission.

completeSharedRules.title: Native rolls and damage
completeSharedRules.wording: Spell attacks use the actual owner's spell attack modifier versus AC: natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles damage dice of that attack, not flat modifiers or later ticks. Saves are binary total-versus-spell-DC, with no natural-die degree shift. A specified examination is an INT (Investigation) task against the creating caster's snapshotted spell DC: use Core degrees/natural shifts, then collapse Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure unless an entry supplies distinct outcomes. For one simultaneous area effect, snapshot geometry and eligible targets before damage, roll each stated shared damage expression once, then apply each recipient's save and actual type defenses independently. Half damage floors each typed component once at the stated save stage. Follow the existing reduction, immunity/resistance/vulnerability, temporary/form buffer, actual HP loss, Wound, death and concentration pipeline. No descriptive Damage/Healing/Control tag supplies an additional attack, damage, healing or condition.

completeSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW explicit use where source timing is absent
completeSharedRules.title: Clocks
completeSharedRules.wording: A bare hostile one-round rider ends at the end of the target's next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn at application; a bare self/ally one-round benefit ends at the start of the caster's next future regular turn. N hostile rounds use the Nth such target end; N buff rounds use the Nth caster start. Outside initiative, those are 6N elapsed seconds. Keep the registered clock through initiative changes using the existing virtual-clock adapter; extra turns do not create expiry/tick opportunities. A NEW duration expressed in minutes/hours below uses an absolute elapsed deadline from completed resolution, including an absolute 60-second deadline for “1 minute”; the one-minute means neither an extra initial tick nor reset when initiative starts. Repeated round damage expressly uses future target regular-end checkpoints and its printed finite count, not one immediate tick plus that count. End-turn ticks/repeat saves precede their scheduled end-turn expiry; start expiry precedes voluntary actions. Suppression pauses eligibility/effect, not deadlines; scheduled suppressed ticks are spent, never queued. Entries that expressly use a named trigger instead of a generic clock keep that trigger.

completeSharedRules.title: Multiplicity, effect identity and present state
completeSharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. Independent class exceptions retain their exact scopes; this is not a universal strongest-effect rule. NEW default for these previously uncompleted spells: one active instance per caster per ordinary spell ID, unless a row expressly permits more; a successfully resolved replacement ends that caster's prior instance, but an illegal/countered attempt does not replace a nonconcentration instance. Different casters retain separate source records, clocks and restrictions; identical numeric bonuses never add. A current complete record is required for every competing effect. Instantaneous completed consequences are not active-instance stock. An entry explicitly limiting waiting triggers counts only its stated waiting state; its spent playback phase never refills or occupies a waiting slot. Continual Flame explicitly permits separate paid anchors, with only its per-anchor limit; do not impose the default one-caster limit on it. Loss, repair, transfer, suppression or a new database ID cannot renew an already consumed mark, scheduled tick, trigger, command budget or source resource. Removal of one source does not erase another's independent condition. Any change in actual target/custody state is logged; it is not a new casting.

completeSharedRules.title: Attack/check marks
completeSharedRules.wording: A row expressly saying attack commitment reserves and spends its mark when the beneficiary commits a legal declared attack, before a roll; cancellation after that commitment and a miss do not refund it, while an illegal declaration that never commits does not spend it. Otherwise “next attack/check” marks spend on the next actual qualifying roll, including a miss/failure; unrelated rolls and passive procedures do not consume them. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. Multiple competing next-roll marks eligible for the same event all spend, though only permitted strongest/advantage effects operate. Suppressed marks do not benefit or consume on an event while suppressed, but their deadline continues. Delivery attacks and later attacks consuming a delivered mark are different events.

completeSharedRules.title: Sight, illusions and meaning
completeSharedRules.wording: An image is not an opaque physical barrier, creature, material, light source, safe floor, sound receiver or extra targetable body unless its row expressly creates that thing. Ordinary hearing needs a real acoustic path; sight needs the relevant illumination, range and unobstructed view. Knowing an illusion does not grant sight through a real wall. For visual/audio deceptions below that permit examination, one Action using a currently accessible relevant sense can make the LR-G03 examination; success identifies that cast as illusory for that observer, while failure permits another examination only after genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive witnessed physical contradiction establishes the applicable false part without a roll. An ally's warning allows examination but does not globally switch every observer to knowing. These procedures do not compel belief, pursuit, an attack, trust or a sale. Current Invisible rules remain: invisibility is not automatic Hidden; observers who know location lose only the special invisibility-derived attack advantage/disadvantage, not unrelated concealment. Language samples reproduce what was heard, not meaning or credentials. Preserve LA's six-second aggregate voluntary-speech budget per numbered round and actual component/oath windows. Spell-created sounds are not the caster's later speech, but original recording speech and the caster's V are real speech.

completeSharedRules.title: Range, targets and geometry
completeSharedRules.wording: Unless a specific row explicitly uses detection without sight, select an actually perceived eligible target or point within the literal Core range and with the existing line of effect. A target can be self within a creature-target range unless the source/row restricts it. “Willing” means current actual consent; an unwilling holder prevents a willing-only object spell without supplying an opposed-roll workaround. Detecting some magic is not necessarily perceiving a creature for targeting it. One target means one physical identity, not every same-named database row. NEW missing cone width is its length at its far end; missing line cross-section is five feet wide and five feet high. All source radii remain radii, not distances added to cast range. Area membership/cover are evaluated from the actual origin at that event; walls are not retroactively removed for a second pass. “Enemies” uses the caster's declared ordinary opposition set, not a supernatural alignment/intent detector. Caster/allies are included in indiscriminate areas. No range is silently replaced by an outside game's value.

completeSharedRules.title: Conditions and hard-control guard
completeSharedRules.wording: Use actual Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed and Stunned definitions without importing another game. Paralyzed/Incapacitated and other hard Action denial obey the current source-character/target/encounter allowance shared across that owner's effects; only successfully established hard control spends it, once for the effect's full allowed window. A blocked hard portion supplies no invented substitute penalty; independently printed damage, Prone or another separately allowed portion can remain. A spell's repeat save ends only the stated source. Ending laughter, restraint or paralysis does not automatically stand a Prone target. NEW “flee” directions below require actual safe available movement away at the next regular-turn movement opportunity, using existing Speed/cost and leaving Actions to the target; they do not force Dash, expend a Reaction or require deliberate self-harm. If no safe farther legal location exists, no movement is forced and no action is lost. Panicked is explicitly bound only in IL-23, not added as a global condition. Haste's voluntary ending cost is separately addressed in R3-12.

completeSharedRules.title: Movement, falls and body continuity
completeSharedRules.wording: Ordinary movement spends real movement cost and needs nonzero permitted Speed, legal support, actual space and the appropriate locomotion mode; changing a speed or mode does not reset spent cost. A spell-directed extra movement allowance expressly stated below supplies only that finite allowance. Teleportation relocates rather than traverses, does not itself provoke opportunity attacks and does not generically defeat a source that blocks relocation; no route is inferred through planes. Check destination occupancy, whole body/gear geometry and lawful carry/load. Supplying a point is not permission to materialize inside another body. Unsupported endings, launches and lost flight use the existing FallMarker and finite falling resolution, not a new immediate damage tick. Actual transformations retain original identity, own HP/resources, spent state, origin restrictions and body/equipment priority; no new monster sheet, harvest pool, HP refill, gear duplication or size-based ability increase. Actual equipment can be melded only by the stated form procedure, stays real weight/history and is unavailable while melded.

completeSharedRules.title: Summons, corpse assets and commands
completeSharedRules.wording: Each row supplies its actual finite body, attack and lifetime rather than importing a monster. Use printed HP/AC before any new fallback. For the NEW profiles below, creating caster's class level/PB/ability at creation fixes any printed-derived maximum; attacks and saves use that same source owner's currently lawful spell attack/PB, not a transferee's or a monster's sheet. Unless stated, saves add owner's PB, ordinary ability/skill checks add 0, normal vision only, no special damage or condition immunity, no independent equipment proficiency or spellcasting. One such spell-created asset per caster per spell ID; the existing total companion/control budget still binds. Creation grants no free attack or movement. A command uses one Bonus Action on the owner's regular turn through actual visible/audible communication within 60 ft; no telepathy is invented. It acts in the attached phase after that whole turn, shares the owner's one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round, and has no independent refresh on extra turns. Uncommanded it can only ordinary Dodge and make defensive movement within speed; no automatic pursuit, work or offense. Loss of the channel means no new command, not free autonomy. A complete task needs its real appendages, capacity, instructions and paid time. At 0 HP, expiry, source dismissal (Action) or concentration end where required, the asset ends; summoned apparatus disappears without loot, corpses, ammunition, harvest or salvage. An actual corpse used as fuel retains its original finite matter/history and the stated terminal consumption; no source can reclassify it as newly obtained material. Keep Ranger's genuinely ordinary animal remains distinct from no-resource summons.

completeSharedRules.title: Suppression and trigger ordering
completeSharedRules.wording: An ongoing magical object's target stays the same physical anchor; transfer or repair cannot duplicate/rearm it. Full magical suppression prevents sensing/operation while it lasts and does not queue missed triggers; duration continues. An acoustic silence can block only sound independently of a physically detected trigger. Resolve simultaneous eligible one-shot triggers in creation order then stable cast ID. Consume a triggered use before its payload, even when a later barrier, silence, immunity, cancellation or receiver state prevents useful output. A sound produced by another real spell can be a phonetic trigger if all actual constraints match, but each waiting trigger resolves at most once and cannot recreate itself or another charge. Source death/distance ends a nonconcentration effect only where the source/row says so; it does not refresh it. Suppression does not undo already completed mundane writing, moved matter, healing, damage or superficial preparation. An explicit persistent permanent spell remains a magical effect, not a manufactured item or free rechargeable device.

completeSharedRules.disposition: NEW spell-specific wrapper family; existing costs/cadence kept
completeSharedRules.title: Copying, acceleration, delay and proxies
completeSharedRules.wording: Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Quick Cast and Delay Spell are the only new wrapper identities authorized here. None may take itself or any of those four as payload, nor may an already echoed/released payload become a replay source. One payload may receive at most one of these temporal/replay modifications; they do not duplicate Ready or grant an additional Bonus Action, Reaction or full Action. Existing acquired class permissions remain their own exceptions, not automatically folded into this family. Select the actual original casting record, same ordinary source class and native legal access; only that spell's normal Action version with one finite resolution is eligible, excluding long casts, Reactions, Bonus Action spells and ongoing maintenance actions. Repeating a miss or resisted but fully resolved cast permits a fresh legal cast, not copying its damage result; a countered or aborted original is not a replay source. New targets/range/components and current costs/statistics must qualify at the new commitment. No active rider, successful roll, other caster's access, expended item charge or selected resource award is copied for free. Cantrip Echo's row defines one composite ordinary-cast transaction; Echo Cast/Quick Cast/Delay Spell instead have their separately paid arming transactions and later actual payload commitments. Record parent, wrapper, payload, cost, original owner and single-use consumption. No zero-base-cost replay recursively generates resource refunds or unearned casts. A legal fresh payload still resolves its own actual damage and expressly funded healing; this guard prevents copied old awards and recursive new-cast/refund grants, not the payload’s specified new outcome. Resonance Tether changes a legitimate delivery origin only, never the responsible caster or their RP/RC pool.

completeSharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast
completeSharedRules.wording: Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror intercept only the first actually resolving ordinary spell effect that has exactly their warded creature as its sole direct creature recipient, beneficial or hostile. Area, multitarget, self-only, anchor/object, summoning, channel/ongoing tick and already redirected effects are ineligible. NEW interception/return distinction: a Touch-delivered, healing or willing-recipient spell is eligible for interception when it satisfies the foregoing sole-recipient and scope requirements. The original caster's eligibility to receive the return, including actual consent and creature-type requirements, is tested only after that eligible ward has been spent. An ineligible original caster therefore causes a spent, unsuccessful return and leaves the original recipient, exactly as below. A legal Touch return uses this explicit magical return, not a new physical touch or Action. No rank cap is added; actual protective exceptions can still forbid redirection. After counterspell resolution but before that spell's attack/save/effect, spend the ward once and substitute the original actual caster as recipient only when it is presently a legal recipient under the payload's own type/other eligibility. The original caster remains owner and supplies DC/attack roll and costs; this creates no new casting, resources or second packet. An ineligible original caster causes the spent redirection to fail and the original spell continues against its original warded target, not automatic cancellation. An eligible redirected attack can miss normally; spend is not refunded. The original targeting distance has already been established; the explicit return uses that same causal cast, with return line blocked by an actual barrier defeating the return path, not arbitrary remote range extension. A blocked return likewise leaves the original target. A causal root can be redirected at most once by these two spells; another mirror on the new target neither redirects it again nor consumes its ward. Duplicate wards on the original target arbitrate earliest creation then stable ID; only the selected ward spends. These are NEW finite interpretations of “first/single-target spell,” not permissions for Wizard/Oracle or other reflected-damage features to use this protocol.

completeSharedRules.title: Necrotic damage, healing, corpses and restrictions
completeSharedRules.wording: Actual damage and healing follow completed Core and feat procedures. No ordinary necrotic spell gains Bleeding, disease, Oracle Decay, a curse, corpse fuel, a soul resource or a healing prohibition by name/tag. A drain's specific permitted funding is stated in its row; an unfunded heal/RP transfer cannot be manufactured from overkill, a reflected packet, an already paid award, target transfer, current permission overriding no-resource origin, or a temporary body. Existing Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch, Lifeleech, Necrotic Affinity, Soul Cage feat and class drains keep their own nonidentical source predicates; the new drain restrictions are not retrospective amendments to them. Actual independently eligible acquired feats can respond once under their completed source rules, never a second time to the resulting heal/resource transfer. A corpse interface uses actual dead identity and retained memory; it does not establish an afterlife, soul custody, truth beyond memory or current thoughts. Preserve actual death/removal clocks, condition and no-resource restrictions through stabilization, question, animation and return. A later paid question cannot retrieve information the old remains never retained; fragments are one donor history, not separate minds.

completeSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW bounded physical work choices
completeSharedRules.title: Real matter, preparations and economy
completeSharedRules.wording: A spell moving or reshaping real matter retains the actual predecessor quantity, material, contents, owner, damage and consumed/harvest history. Count retained mass and disposed matter once. It does not change source tier, named ingredient eligibility, equipment grade, formula knowledge, rarity, assigned value, an old recovery claim or an apparatus's paid service/charges. Cosmetic temperature/color/shape does not sterilize food, undo spoilage, neutralize a poison or supply a professional crafting result. Explicit elementary structures allowed below still need real support and dimensions; no unknown material or hidden load-bearing property is authenticated by the spell. A genuine subsequently usable mundane item can enter only its actual existing rules and finite market; no automatic sale price, buyer, XP or crafting-output multiplication. Fulfilled 687/433 recipe and NWX/LA procedures remain controlling.

completeSharedRules.title: Concentration and early termination
completeSharedRules.wording: Where a row says concentration, it occupies the one actual concentration slot, ends under the completed damage-save/incapacitation rules and can be ended voluntarily under that rule; no new per-round maintenance RP is imposed. A source explicitly printing concentration keeps it even when an independent rider ends sooner. NEW voluntary early termination for a nonconcentration instance authored below requires the original caster's Action and actual perception of its anchor/recipient within that spell's original range; no remote recall or refund. Instant completed consequences cannot be voluntarily reversed. Named permanent Until Dispelled effects have no general voluntary end from this default; use their own source or actual dispel. Invalid physical continued operation removes only what can no longer function; full destruction of a required anchor ends its anchored instance. No repaired anchor is a new instance.

completeSharedRules.title: Aliases and unassigned variants
completeSharedRules.wording: Uncontrollable Laughter uses the matching historical Tasha's Hideous Laughter Core metadata only through the explicit IL-18 binding; Resonance Tether analogously uses Mana Tether through UN-13. Preserve both historical names, exact effects and alias records without adding separate ordinary identities. Prestidigitation's two actual school modes are independently specified in IL-06 and selected by the cast's actual access row. Phantasmal Force rank 3, Stone Shape rank 4 and Mislead rank 5 remain preserved unassigned alternative records: no current classAccess row acquires those higher-rank modes, no chooser can buy them by paying more RP, and no new question or ordinary promotion is invented for them. The assigned lower-rank modes receive complete directions. Echo Cast's Core “base RP” is the chosen operational reading of its catalog's broader shorthand. Soul Tap's catalog HP AND Resonance selects the joint operation explicitly. Unravel Spell's “Tier 4” means the generating ordinary spell's rank≤4, not material/equipment/creature tier. All differences stay beside unchanged competing source fields.

completeSharedRules.title: Audience and comparison records
completeSharedRules.wording: All 137 selected ordinary identities and 141 original book bindings remain preserved internally; public teaching uses only actual public fields and the resulting operational mode when later exactly reviewed. A source mention does not publish a private dossier, class membership, material source or hidden research metadata. The 54 full selected class comparisons and 114 distinct spell counterparts retain their actual IDs, resource engines, windows and statuses; matching names/words do not merge any of them. Pending feats and spell comparisons stay pending. The eight submitted proposals are separately disposed below as source directions, not adopted by their mere inclusion. No change to the fulfilled language, teaching or recipe authority is required by these ordinary directions.

completeSharedRules.title: Delivery and deferred receipts
completeSharedRules.wording: R3-04 Blink is receipt-only: retain its full original and question, current pending operational state and literal setting references; author no plane itinerary, probability, reappearance/body procedure or promotion. Other incidental literal names, including Silent Ones, Heartcell, Matrix, Voice and deep-language terms when present, remain source receipts without interpretation. Local portals/teleports below are explicitly local procedures, not a decision about cosmology. Source authority here does not certify gameplay runtime, human teaching/balance, bestiary/acquisition availability, DD01 or final systemic consistency. Owner's final whole-game flow precedes an authorized GitHub push; verified remote commit precedes careful cosmology review. No deletion/push is authorized.
