sourceConflict.catalog: Rulebook catalog says only: Send a creature to another plane temporarily; catalog duration unspecified.
sourceConflict.core: Core entry supplies Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, 7 RP and duration Instantaneous.
sourceConflict.disposition: Preserve both original records unchanged. For provisional runnability, author NEW concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds while retaining Instantaneous as historical/source metadata. This is an explicit authored reconciliation, not a rewrite of either source.

questionDispositions.reason: A generated isolated extraplanar spell-cell preserves the printed temporary-other-plane effect without naming or identifying any reviewed plane. The draft topology is retained only as a local spell-space and revised to an elastic finite enclosure so body/atomic geometry changes do not require a hidden preemptive interrupt.

Use Action/60 ft/V-S-F/base 7 RP and actual class spell DC; NEW CHA save, willing pre-roll failure, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, one-live-application guard, and the existing shared hard-control allowance. Concentration begins at legal cast commitment and a failed/countered cast does not restore displaced concentration.

Use finite BAN-CLOSE-03. No pre-change early-return interrupt exists. Mandatory source events resolve normally. When Banishment ends, remaining identities are moved to the snapshotted origin plane despite a narrow terminal endpoint-blocker exception, then physical fitting is resolved by the already accepted canonical placement procedure. An unresolved physical placement conflict is an origin-plane state, not continuing exile.

Independently legal visitors and internally created creatures retain their own real permissions/costs. Their source must target a currently fitting, perceived in-cell footprint; Banishment cannot expand first to create target legality. At closure, all remaining real identities are returned once in stable order and handed to canonical placement; ended/escaped/consumed identities are not recreated.

The spell transports exactly the selected creature plus genuine noncreature worn/carried gear. Separate creature bodies—including passengers, mounts, swallowed creatures and companions—do not become gear. Impossible separation/tethers can defeat establishment. Transformations, death, body removal, Null Disabled summons and cargo keep their own source lifecycles.

Use accepted AC4 interfaces: rank-4 Banishment is ineligible for Spell Shield; Dimensional Anchor blocks ordinary planar endpoints; Resonance Beacon remains same-plane; Xi can end only the actual ongoing target branch with its exact consent/perception/range/charge procedure. Cleric Banish Unholy remains a different class technique.

Keep Paladin cards exact. NEW BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 classifies this spell only as planar/extradimensional displacement, not teleportation. No Escape blocks only voluntarily accepted Banishment because it expressly includes voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute does not block Banishment because it names only teleportation/invisibility; Reign of Ashes does not block because it denies benefit from Dash/teleportation. A pre-save acceptance flag determines voluntary versus forced admission whether the target elects failure or rolls.

BAN-ADMIT-03 allows a visitor/created body only through its own real destination/creation permission, cost and a fitting currently perceived in-cell footprint. No expansion can supply prior target perception/LoE. After legal establishment the cell may expand only for clearance. Admission grants no route, knowledge, immunity or return resource.

No universal interrupt or rewind is created. Mandatory transformations/death/expiry complete under their actual source. Cell geometry expands after mandatory in-cell anatomy changes as needed. Final Banishment ending uses BAN-CLOSE-03 and canonical placement-conflict handling on the origin plane; no future ruling is needed for ordinary collapse/filled-space cases.

Accepted AC4 procedures are interoperability authority only within their recorded scope; lexical class hits are navigation evidence only. Preserve all historical scenario text as evidence, author current adjudications separately, and claim no runtime/human/balance approval.

identity.name: Banishment
identity.printedEffect: Send a creature to another plane temporarily.
identity.status: NEW provisional authored playtest candidate; source Instantaneous metadata preserved as evidence

castAndSave.target: One actually perceived creature within 60 feet and line of effect, including the caster; not a corpse, image, soul record or unattended object.
castAndSave.commit: Validate known class/repertoire, V/S/F, Action, range/line of effect, affordability, concentration permission, obvious body/custody impossibilities and obvious transport blocks. Pay the actual final spell price and perform ordinary cast/counter timing. NEW concentration begins at legal cast commitment and displaces incompatible prior concentration normally.
castAndSave.save: NEW BAN-SAVE-01: target makes a Charisma save against the actual casting-class spell DC. Before rolling, target records admissionIntent = ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT may either elect automatic failure or roll normally; if it rolls and fails, establishment is still voluntary. RESIST plus failed save is involuntary. Actual save bonuses/defenses apply, including Fate-Bound Boon IV +2 against banishment. Success creates no cell and no exile.
castAndSave.hardControl: On a failed save, establishment is one hard encounter-removal component under the existing source-character/target/encounter hard-control allowance. If that allowance cannot be claimed, no exile/cell is established and no soft fallback is invented. The paid cast remains spent.
castAndSave.oneLive: Only one live ordinary Banishment application may attach to the same creature. An attached target cannot receive a second application; no replacement, stacked cell or timer refresh.
castAndSave.preflightAddendum: Apply BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 and target-side restrictions before commitment when known. No Escape blocks admissionIntent=ACCEPT because Banishment enters extradimensional travel. Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block this non-teleport planar displacement. A hidden/new blocker may still defeat establishment after costs commit under ordinary spell integration.
castAndSave.admissionIntent: Before the save, record ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT is voluntary admission whether the target elects failure or actually rolls and fails. RESIST remains forced on a failed save. This Banishment-only predicate is used only where an exact source distinguishes voluntary extradimensional travel.

cell.classification: NEW narrowly scoped temporary Banishment spell-space; names no canonical plane
cell.planeIdentity: A distinct temporary extraplanar spell-cell generated by this spell. It is not identified with any named reviewed plane, afterlife, deity, Heartcell state, soul destination, natural origin or campaign era.
cell.coordinates: Cell-local x=east, y=north, z=up. Floor is z=0. The primary arrives with the center of its horizontal footprint at local (0,0) in its current orientation.
cell.initialGeometry: Initial horizontal extent equals the primary's actual footprint plus 5 feet of clearance on every side; round each total horizontal axis upward to the next 5 feet. Height equals actual occupied body height plus 5 feet overhead, rounded upward to the next 5 feet. Example: Medium 5x5 body with occupied height 6 feet starts in x[-7.5,+7.5], y[-7.5,+7.5], z[0,15]. A Tiny 2.5x2.5 body also receives a 15x15 horizontal cell after rounding.
cell.supportAndEnvironment: The entire current cell floor is level ephemeral support. The cell supplies ordinary light and a nonharmful spell-local sustaining medium sufficient for an admitted body's already-established respiration needs. This grants no stock, harvest, resistance, immunity, amphibious trait or cosmological fact.
cell.boundaries: Cell boundaries are opaque to mundane sight/sound and ordinary line of effect/passage. A source cannot target space beyond the current boundary and rely on later expansion to make that target legal.
cell.voluntaryGeometry: Voluntary body-size/shape changes follow their actual source and BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md preflight against the current in-cell volume. Banishment does not expand first to legalize a voluntary change.
cell.mandatoryGeometry: An actual mandatory ending/reversion/death/body-lifecycle event is never failed, delayed or negated to preserve cell geometry. Resolve it first under its source. If the resulting current body needs more room, expand the cell outward after the mandatory event, only enough to contain all extant bodies plus 5 feet clearance. Expansion moves no body and creates no new target permission.
cell.materiality: Floor/walls/light/sustaining medium are ephemeral spell boundaries with no inventory identity, sale, harvest or residue.

agencyAndClocks.duration: NEW concentration, maximum 60 elapsed seconds from successful establishment. Record absolute deadline establishment+60 seconds. In initiative, preserve the equivalent tenth future regular-start marker only as a display aid; the absolute deadline controls cross-mode transitions.
agencyAndClocks.agency: Primary and any admitted visitors retain their actual Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, movement, concentration, conditions, HP, death saves, resources and class permissions. Banishment itself adds no Incapacitated, restraint, stasis, healing or rest.
agencyAndClocks.clocks: All existing condition, summon, concentration, Opening/Horn, Hunt, Stable/death and other real deadlines continue 1:1. Extra turns/initiative changes do not refresh them.
agencyAndClocks.ending: Caster may end its own concentration through the ordinary no-action concentration permission. Caster Incapacitated/concentration failure/end, the absolute deadline, successful Xi termination, actual dispel/end of this application, or suppression of this Banishment application initiates closure immediately. NEW Banishment-specific suppression rule: because suppression disables the exile/cell effect itself, suppression closes and ends this application rather than pausing it for later resumption.

transportAndCustody.primaryTransport: On successful establishment transport the same selected creature identity and only its genuine noncreature worn/carried gear within actual custody/carrying/dimensional limits.
transportAndCustody.separateBodies: No separate creature is converted into gear. A mount, carried passenger, swallowed separate creature, controlled companion or other distinct creature remains at origin. Before establishment, separate it into a legal origin placement if possible. If actual anatomy/restraint makes separation impossible, establishment fails atomically; paid cast/commit history remains, and the hard-control allowance is not spent because exile never established.
transportAndCustody.tethers: An external tether/fixture does not travel merely because attached. If no current rule permits legal separation and the selected body cannot move intact without transporting another body/fixed structure, establishment fails atomically.
transportAndCustody.objects: Record transported object IDs and custody. Consumed, destroyed, transferred or independently removed objects remain consumed/destroyed/transferred/removed. No ending event duplicates inventory.

admission.externalVisitor: A different creature can enter only through an independently legal source that truly reaches this generated cell, satisfies that source's destination knowledge/perception/range/cost requirements, and designates a fitting unoccupied footprint already inside the current cell. The current 49-source set does not prove a generic route to an unknown cell.
admission.internalCreation: An occupant may create/summon a body only through its actual source and only into a fitting unoccupied footprint it can currently perceive/target inside the cell. Pay the source's real Action/RP/frequency/concentration/command costs. No pre-cast cell expansion may supply missing target space or line of effect.
admission.postEstablishmentExpansion: After a visitor/created body legally establishes in an already-valid in-cell footprint, the cell may expand outward only to restore the ordinary 5-foot clearance around extant bodies. That expansion is not part of source preflight.
admission.effect: Admission does not attach Banishment to the secondary body and grants no reusable return route, destination knowledge, immunity, action or resource. Its own independent lifecycle remains real.

escape.rule: Any occupant may use an independently legal escape/travel source exactly as written, paying its actual costs and satisfying its own destination, perception, range, geometry and blocker requirements. Banishment supplies none of those prerequisites.
escape.primaryEscape: If the primary legally leaves the cell, the Banishment application ends immediately. In that same resolution sequence, BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining secondary body/object, then destroys the cell even if it is already empty. The escaped primary is not pulled back.
escape.secondaryEscape: A secondary body that independently leaves remains at its legal destination and is absent from later closure.
escape.failure: A failed escape spends only source-defined costs/history and leaves the body in the cell.

closure.classification: NEW Banishment-only finite ending. The spell-cell ends; physical fit is then handed to the accepted canonical BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST placement-conflict procedure rather than protected closure anchors.
closure.trigger: Every Banishment application ending invokes closure: deadline, concentration end, valid Xi/end/suppression, or primary legal escape. Invoke even for an empty cell; an empty ephemeral cell simply ceases.
closure.originPlane: At successful establishment snapshot the primary target's actual origin-plane identity as an opaque existing plane reference and its fixed world anchor/orientation. The anchor never rides with a later-moving platform/vehicle. This records location only and does not name or settle cosmology.
closure.secondaryAnchors: When a secondary body first legally establishes in the cell, record a deterministic origin-plane closure anchor by projecting its cell-local horizontal/vertical offset from the primary local origin onto the primary's fixed world axes. This creates metadata only: no origin-plane space is reserved, protected, excluded or altered.
closure.looseObjectAnchors: At closure start, carried gear remains with its actual carrier. For each genuinely loose surviving object, project its current cell-local position onto the primary fixed world anchor to obtain an item placement anchor. Consumed/destroyed/escaped objects are absent.
closure.mandatoryPlaneReturn: For every remaining extant body/corpse/object, end the extraplanar spell state and assign it to the snapshotted origin plane before physical placement. This transition is mandatory and is not a voluntary teleport.
closure.endpointBlockerException: NEW narrowly scoped Banishment terminal exception: if a current Dimensional Anchor or other true endpoint transport-prevention predicate would block this mandatory closure transition, ignore only that prevention predicate for the terminal return. Do not ignore physical terrain, occupancy, anatomy, support, death/body removal, item existence or any voluntary-travel rule. This exception grants no future transport privilege and cannot be used for escape or another spell.
creatureOrder: primary current body/corpse if still present
secondary creature bodies by stable admission order
closure.creaturePlacement: For each returned creature/corpse in order, apply BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md Placement and involuntary endings at that entity's closure anchor: (1) normal current-anatomy space at same position; (2) legal squeeze under COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md; (3) nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, using minimum displacement, then greatest overlap with the previous/anchor footprint, then the fixed neutral board order. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space and does not search farther afield.
closure.multiEntityPlacement: Resolve entities in the stated stable order. A body already legally placed is ordinary occupied space for later entities. If that leaves a later entity with no same-anchor/squeeze/nearest-adjacent candidate, the later entity records a placement conflict; earlier legal placements are not undone.
closure.placementConflictState: If the inherited same-anchor → legal squeeze → nearest legal adjacent/same-unobstructed-region placement procedure produces no legal footprint, Banishment still ends and the cell is destroyed. Preserve the same extant identity on the snapshotted origin plane with placementConflict=true and a fixed closureAnchorReference. NEW BAN-CONFLICT-04 does not create a global body condition: it adds only Banishment-origin conflict semantics. The closureAnchorReference is the creature's logical spatial location for measuring range and evaluating source predicates while no legal occupied footprint exists. Do not grant movement, adjacency, occupancy, cover, squeezing, wall passage, overlap, flanking, support contact or other footprint-dependent benefits merely from that reference. Perception and line of effect are evaluated from the closureAnchorReference through the actual current terrain using the exact source's normal rules; solid barriers can therefore block them. Self-targeting and other effects that do not require a legal occupied footprint may still be used if all of their own prerequisites are met. Actions/Reactions are not categorically forbidden: evaluate each one by its actual activation, component, range, target, perception, path and geometry requirements. Ordinary movement cannot begin because there is no legal occupied footprint/path origin, but an independently legal relocation effect can resolve the conflict if it can lawfully use the anchor reference as its source location and establish a legal destination. All HP, Wounds, conditions, concentration, summon, death and other real clocks continue. Already-attached effects remain attached unless their own source ends them. When an obstruction is actually removed/changed so placement becomes possible, rerun the inherited placement procedure from the same anchor with the then-current anatomy; that mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no movement riders. When a legal relocation effect succeeds, move the same identity to its legal destination and clear placementConflict.
closure.fallingAndSupport: Evaluate real terrain/support at the closureAnchorReference for source predicates while placementConflict persists, but do not invent an occupied footprint. A conflicted body does not begin Falling merely because the reference point is unsupported; ordinary Falling begins when the body is actually placed in a legal unsupported footprint or a legal relocation establishes one. If closure itself finds a legal unsupported footprint, place the body there and start ordinary Falling immediately. Banishment never moves the body directly to ground.
closure.objects: After creature handling, settle loose noncreature objects by stable object-ID using the existing equipment rule: place at its anchor/current legal item position or nearest legal adjacent item position; if no legal drop exists, record that item's placement as pending. It continues to exist and is not duplicated, destroyed or used to displace another creature.
closure.deathAndRemoval: Mandatory death, source expiry, concentration ending, Polymorph reversion, actual-0-HP ending, cargo release and other true source events are never failed or delayed for Banishment geometry. A remaining corpse returns as that same corpse. A vanished/expired summon body is not recreated. Hunted Death/finality and ordinary item provenance remain unchanged.
closure.cellEnd: After every remaining identity is either legally placed, recorded as an origin-plane placement conflict/pending item, or confirmed absent, destroy the ephemeral cell immediately. No placement conflict keeps Banishment or its concentration alive.

currentInterfaces.spellShield: Banishment is generating rank 4 and therefore does not satisfy accepted Spell Shield rank 0–3 eligibility, regardless of discounts.
currentInterfaces.dimensionalAnchor: At establishment, Dimensional Anchor applies under its accepted endpoint rule and can defeat the planar transition. During voluntary escape it applies normally. At BAN-CLOSE-03 terminal ending, the mandatory-plane-return step uses only the narrowly scoped endpointBlockerException; physical fit is never ignored and is resolved afterward by BAN-PLACEMENT-HANDOFF-03.
currentInterfaces.resonanceBeacon: Beacon requires same-plane traveler/beacon. A Beacon outside the cell does not become same-plane. A Beacon created inside obeys its actual rules but does not create an outside destination.

completeCatalogCard.name: Barrier Field

operational.targets: One fixed center point on suitable approximately horizontal immobile ground or surface within range and line of effect, with space for a 15-foot-radius hemisphere.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: Automatic after legal placement. Creation neither displaces nor damages creatures. The field is faintly visible.
operational.effect: Create a 15-foot-radius hemisphere, 15 feet high, with no floor. In both directions its curved boundary blocks attack rolls whose attack/effect path crosses it, including melee reach, and blocks the directly damaging portion of harmful effects crossing it, including save-based or automatic magical damage. Damage from an area on one side does not propagate through the boundary to the other. REVIEWED ORIGIN CLARIFICATION: for a cast that directly deals damage, trace from its caster to the target or initial area origin; merely choosing the area center beyond the field does not bypass it. A damaging part that must cross is blocked regardless of friendly intent or recipient willingness. Other legal, separable non-damaging parts resolve normally. The initial establishment of a persistent damaging source must also satisfy this boundary rule. Once legally established, its subsequent packets use its actual current origin.
operational.limitations: Creatures and ordinary nonattack movement cross freely. The field does not block ordinary light, sound or gas, nondamaging control or information magic, teleportation, or effects genuinely originating and resolving entirely on the same side. A previously established independent effect uses its actual source origin and is not ended by field creation. It grants no one-way attacks, HP, item identity, cover item, entrapment, floor, platform or structural support. Unsupported Falling crosses normally without extra movement. It does not erase resolved damage or negate an entire spell merely because its damage across the boundary is blocked. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 15-foot cast range, 15-foot hemisphere, V/S/F, concentration 1 minute and physical/magical attack protection. NEW: fixed visible hemisphere, two-way attack/direct-damage boundary, no floor, free creature passage and explicit nondamaging exceptions. Direct-damage origin/intent and persistent-source establishment follow the reviewed interpretation.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime and balance validation pending

completeCatalogCard.name: Counterspell

operational.activation: Reaction — when another creature you can perceive within range and line of effect begins casting a spell, after its casting costs and cadence are committed but before its effect resolves
operational.targets: One pending spell cast by the triggering creature. The spell needs an actual recorded rank; the Director may know that rank without revealing it to you.
operational.duration: Instantaneous
operational.resolution: make a spellcasting-ability check using the actual ability for the class through which you cast Counterspell, adding PB once, against DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank (rank 0 contributes 0). Use CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md's fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts: at least DC+10 Critical Success, at least DC Success, at most DC-10 Critical Failure, otherwise Failure; natural 20 improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one. Collapse both upper degrees to success and both lower degrees to failure; invent no additional critical effect. This is not a spell attack or saving throw.
operational.effect: Success negates the selected pending spell after its costs were committed; failure lets it continue. Every interruptible cast first commits its RP/material/other costs, components, concentration transition, Dissonance/Refrain and exact beginning/casting hooks once, then opens the interruption window. A surviving cast later resolves its effect and outcome-dependent hooks. Negation gives no refund, no successful-effect trigger and no restoration of old concentration. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out; if a counter is negated, the earlier pending spell resumes without paying or casting again. Resuming a parent never rewrites the later nested cast's Refrain/Dissonance history.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic success against lower ranks and no generic upcast.
operational.limitations: One attempt per creature against a particular pending cast, shared across ordinary, Wizard, Mage and other same-named Counterspell sources. An exact source that expressly grants an additional Counterspell attempt against the same pending cast overrides this default; merely granting another Reaction does not. After a failed attempt another eligible creature may react; once negated, the spell supplies no further interruption trigger. All reactions need their own legal remaining resource, components, range and current source permissions. Attempting does not reveal spell identity/rank; never treat an unassigned rank as 0 or estimate it from RP. Ready opens its cast-interruption window at preparation, not release. Countering is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that ledger. Ordinary Counterspell requires ordinary repertoire/class access and rank-3 cost; Wizard/Mage same-named class cards keep their own separate acquisition, printed costs, ranks, recharge and text. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: both Abjuration/Universal rank-3 placements, Reaction, 60 feet, V/S/F and instantaneous interruption. NEW: actual casting ability+PB against DC 10+2*rank, one attempt per pending cast, hidden-rank handling and nested timing. REVIEWED SOURCE CORRECTION: the earlier binary-check proposal is superseded by the existing Core fixed-DC task rule, with natural shifts and collapsed success/failure outcomes. Exact source permission may override the shared attempt limit; another Reaction alone cannot.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime and balance validation pending

completeAuthoredCard.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. NEW: create a fixed 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within range and line of effect, with concentration up to one minute. It prevents an actual teleportation or planar-transition transaction when any transported body’s origin or destination footprint intersects the area. Cargo travels with its actual body; an object transported independently uses its own endpoints. Do not test an imaginary path between two outside endpoints. Ordinary travel through the area remains possible. The rule applies to willing, hostile and self transport using established location records; it creates no destination or plane. A portal can remain present, but transit using a blocked endpoint cannot complete. A known obstruction fails preflight before payment; hidden obstruction or a field established after commitment can defeat a paid transit, leaving the entire transaction at its origin. Atomic group travel fails together, without splitting bodies or inventory. Ending or suppressing the field allows future otherwise legal transactions but does not retry or refund past attempts. The field does not suppress summons, images, mundane movement, physical forced displacement, spells generally, or effects merely because they once crossed space. There is no save or physical cage. An explicit source exception can bypass only the prevention it actually names.
completeAuthoredCard.newChoices: NEW: fixed sphere, minute concentration and endpoint-based prevention, with atomic group failure and separate casting range and radius.
historicalWorkedCases: Both teleport endpoints outside the sphere permit transit even if a straight line between them crosses the sphere.
A portal can remain visible while its endpoint is blocked. A transit defeated after commitment leaves the traveler and real gear at the origin, with costs spent.

completeSharedRules.castingEngine: Use SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md exactly: legal action/components/target/repertoire first; class-specific rank/cost; pre-cast Dissonance; commit RP/materials/concentration; apply Dissonance/Refrain/cast-begin hooks; resolve interruption; then effect. Failed/countered/saved casts refund nothing.
completeSharedRules.timing:
One-minute concentration effects use the source's normal ten future caster regular-start markers in initiative or 60 elapsed seconds outside unless this card states a different exact clock. Ten minutes = 100 future caster regular-start markers or 600 elapsed seconds. Alignment Lock uses 24 elapsed hours; rank-7 Alignment Anchor uses seven elapsed days; Bind Element uses two future target regular ends / 12 elapsed seconds outside initiative. Preserve virtual/absolute deadlines through initiative changes, absence and suppression.
SPELL SHIELD EXACT CLOCK — Because Spell Shield is nonconcentration, its own one-minute deadline is explicit: in initiative, application records the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application, excluding any start already in progress or past. Outside initiative, deadline = application timestamp + 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve that fixed virtual/absolute deadline across initiative entry/exit, reorder, extra turns, absence, caster death and suppression. Caster death alone does not end Spell Shield.
completeSharedRules.null: Creation-time Null root identity remains governed by accepted EPI-08–14. Pure transfer/redirection preserves the root flag. New reflected/retaliatory damage only uses a new root when an exact effect says it creates new damage. Finite summons reduced to 0 by qualifying Null damage use the accepted Disabled branch while independent expiry/concentration/replacement remains real.
completeSharedRules.faction: Use standing-v1 separately from membership and invocation permission. Faction Seal's reviewed invocation-permission procedure is the permission reference where invoked. Positive standing never creates membership or permission.
completeSharedRules.alignment: Reviewed Alignment Purge AP-AS-01 remains exactly source-specific. AC4-ALIGN-01 is an additional NEW scoped exception only for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor; it creates no universal alignment priority engine.
completeSharedRules.banishment: Banishment is not one of these fifteen. The earlier pre-push sequencing hold is historical. Its exact source receipt is preserved and it remains the next separate procedure-authoring obligation using current planes/souls sources.
completeSharedRules.summonTargeting: NEW scoped AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01: solely for the two authored AC4 temporary profiles Summon Water Pet and Faction Envoy, while their finite body exists they count as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This is a mechanical targeting classification only; it establishes no natural origin, biology, soul, corpse, loot, undead/construct taxonomy or cosmological identity. Null Disabled 0 remains the same existing body and may receive an otherwise legal heal; an ended/expired/dismissed body is no longer a target. Resonance Beacon uses active-creature identity rather than biological 'living' status: an enrolled creature must still be able to spend its own Action and RP.

completeAuthoredCard.procedure: Action; range 500 feet; V/S/F; instantaneous. Teleport yourself and your actually worn/carried legal gear to one known fitting unoccupied destination on the same established plane. NEW: known means personally perceived now or personally occupied/examined before, with an accurate fixed location relative to your current position. Rumor, approximate direction, imagined layout or a map alone is insufficient. This expressly permits an unseen known destination without line of effect or a traversed path, but grants no remote senses or new place knowledge. Choose one exact footprint and orientation before payment. Recheck occupancy, actual transport prohibitions and custody at resolution. A hidden or newly invalid destination leaves you and all gear at the origin with costs spent, without damage, partial arrival or an automatic nearest-safe substitute. No passenger is granted: a willing or unwilling carried creature is not gear. A genuinely carried unattended object can travel within actual carrying limits, keeping its identity and ownership. Unsupported free space is permitted if the body fits, then ordinary Falling begins immediately; there is no hover. Transit does not end unrelated conditions unless their actual source or physical relationship ends. This Conjuration identity remains distinct from Universal Dimension Door and borrows none of its unreviewed rules.

completeAuthoredCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; concentration up to one minute. Require actual membership in a recorded faction and actual invocation permission; favorable standing alone is insufficient. NEW: summon one willing temporary faction-affiliated ally using the complete Faction Envoy profile below, in a perceived fitting unoccupied supported space with line of effect. The profile is designed for the source’s nominal CR 3 role; balance and CR certification remain open. The current public CR-3 entries do not establish both finished mechanics and this caster’s faction relationship; their original profiles remain comparison evidence. Temporary affiliation grants no institutional membership, credentials, secrets, reputation or alignment. Member-only benefits require actual separate membership evidence. The Envoy acts immediately after your regular turn under the actual Bonus Action command and shared offensive-action allowance, using only the profile’s listed actions. Without a command it can move defensively and Dodge. One Envoy per caster; successful replacement or concentration/source ending removes the old body. Ordinary non-Null damage that reaches 0 invokes the finite-summon endpoint and removes it; qualifying Null damage instead uses the Disabled-at-0 rule below. Real borrowed cargo drops legally without duplication; its conjured blade vanishes. Suppression preserves the same body, HP and deadline without actions, healing or a fresh summon event until resumption. No autonomous attack, loot, corpse, soul/resource reward, free Help or unknown faction information is granted. This summons one finite body; it does not requisition a real NPC or publish Director-only traits.

CURRENT FACTION INTERFACE — `caster faction` requires actual recorded membership in one exact canonical faction AND actual source/campaign invocation permission under the reviewed Faction Seal permission procedure. Affiliation, favorable `standing-v1`, disguise, information access, or the Envoy's temporary descriptor cannot substitute for either gate. Faction Sanctuary's caster invocation permission remains its own gate and does not itself make a Sanctuary recipient a member. The temporary Envoy's `faction-affiliated` descriptor is source-limited to this summon and is not institutional membership; it cannot satisfy member-only Sanctuary, credentials, reputation, or access.

CURRENT NULL/LIFECYCLE INTERFACE — A qualifying `nullNonlethal=true` damage root that reduces this finite summoned companion from positive HP to 0, or later strikes that same already-`Null Disabled 0` body, does not end, replace or reapply the body/state. Use the accepted `finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast` branch: the same identity becomes `Null Disabled 0` (Incapacitated, Speed 0, no Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions/commands) while the original spell/concentration/deadline continues. Independent concentration end, duration expiry, dismissal or replacement still ends the body. A real healing source whose targeting applies under NEW scoped AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01 can raise it above 0 and end Disabled; no generic free heal, resummon refresh, or corpse/loot is created.

historicalWorkedCases: The Envoy’s two attack components use one commanded offensive Action, leaving no shared offensive allowance for another companion that round.
Favorable reputation alone does not authorize this cast without actual faction membership and invocation permission.

Failed/countered/saved casts refund nothing.
completeSharedRules.timing:
One-minute concentration effects use the source's normal ten future caster regular-start markers in initiative or 60 elapsed seconds outside unless this card states a different exact clock. Ten minutes = 100 future caster regular-start markers or 600 elapsed seconds. Alignment Lock uses 24 elapsed hours; rank-7 Alignment Anchor uses seven elapsed days; Bind Element uses two future target regular ends / 12 elapsed seconds outside initiative. Preserve virtual/absolute deadlines through initiative changes, absence and suppression.
SPELL SHIELD EXACT CLOCK — Because Spell Shield is nonconcentration, its own one-minute deadline is explicit: in initiative, application records the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application, excluding any start already in progress or past. Outside initiative, deadline = application timestamp + 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve that fixed virtual/absolute deadline across initiative entry/exit, reorder, extra turns, absence, caster death and suppression. Caster death alone does not end Spell Shield.
completeSharedRules.null: Creation-time Null root identity remains governed by accepted EPI-08–14. Pure transfer/redirection preserves the root flag. New reflected/retaliatory damage only uses a new root when an exact effect says it creates new damage. Finite summons reduced to 0 by qualifying Null damage use the accepted Disabled branch while independent expiry/concentration/replacement remains real.
completeSharedRules.faction: Use standing-v1 separately from membership and invocation permission. Faction Seal's reviewed invocation-permission procedure is the permission reference where invoked. Positive standing never creates membership or permission.
completeSharedRules.alignment: Reviewed Alignment Purge AP-AS-01 remains exactly source-specific. AC4-ALIGN-01 is an additional NEW scoped exception only for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor; it creates no universal alignment priority engine.
completeSharedRules.banishment: Banishment is not one of these fifteen. The earlier pre-push sequencing hold is historical. Its exact source receipt is preserved and it remains the next separate procedure-authoring obligation using current planes/souls sources.

This is a mechanical targeting classification only; it establishes no natural origin, biology, soul, corpse, loot, undead/construct taxonomy or cosmological identity. Null Disabled 0 remains the same existing body and may receive an otherwise legal heal; an ended/expired/dismissed body is no longer a target. completeCatalogCard.name: Faction Portal

operational.targets: One legal open local entrance space you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect, on suitable ground. Choose one exact canonical factionId with a recorded current reputation score above 0 and one specific known headquarters of that faction.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: No roll. On successful casting create one visible, fixed, one-way doorway 5 feet wide and8 feet high. The destination is a known established public/default receiving point for the chosen headquarters, or, absent such a point, one specific known ordinary primary entrance/foyer. Identify it from personal experience or reliable public information; no existing portal infrastructure is needed. It may be on the same or another plane. Recheck each actual crossing against legal arrival space and exact teleport/planar blockers; failure leaves the crossing creature and belongings at the local entrance, with no split or deletion.
operational.effect:
Any creature that physically fits the entrance under ordinary anatomy/squeezing rules may use it; passengers need no positive reputation or faction membership. Entering costs 5 feet of ordinary movement, subject to ordinary movement-cost adjustments, and atomically transports that creature and its legally carried belongings to a legal unoccupied space at or adjacent to the chosen receiving point. Ordinary carried creatures may accompany it only within the carrier's actual anatomy, pound and Load capacity and with room for the whole arriving group; this does not create willing-target immunity against being actually carried. Choose the receiving point when casting and keep it fixed. At each crossing use the nearest legal space at/adjacent to that point that fits the whole group, with a fixed neutral board order for ties, never a tactical remote choice or search through barriers. If none exists, the crossing fails and the attempted movement remains spent. Ordinary approach movement can provoke opportunity attacks; the teleport transition itself cannot. Items carried through remain the same items with actual ownership, contents, conditions and provenance. Loose unattended objects do not independently activate transit: a creature must physically carry or legally handle them as part of its own crossing; thrown projectiles, remote pushes and spells cannot deliver goods through by themselves.

The doorway is opaque to sight and sound and supplies no line of effect through it. Attacks, spells, areas, projectiles and remote sensing do not pass. There is no exit doorway or automatic return route. Complete a currently resolving legal crossing atomically before closing/suppressing the doorway; expiry never bisects a body or cargo. Later crossings require the still-active doorway. Suppression makes it unusable without pausing its endpoint. It has no physical HP, support or barrier body; when inactive there is no active transit surface. One portal per caster; a successful replacement closes the old one. Current positive reputation is checked as a creation gate at cast start and resolution, not a continuing passenger credential; a later standing change does not itself close a created portal.
operational.limitations: Use the actual canonical reputation record: positive means above 0, normally+1 through+3 under REPUTATION.md; missing/0/negative standing fails the gate. This card does not replace that scale with the historical Gameplay Loop's -5..+5 scale. No faction membership, Seal invocation permission, headquarters infrastructure or automatic entry authorization is added. If there are several HQs, select exactly one known site; no hidden vault, secret room, unknown HQ, location search or knowledge report. The far endpoint needs no originating line of sight/effect and has no geographic range ceiling, but actual wards and legal placement still apply. A headquarters that ceases to exist or belong to the faction cannot receive new crossings; a purely clerical name change does not move the chosen physical point. Failed crossings reveal no cause beyond failure, although ordinary observers may draw inferences. The spell can bypass a geographic route leg and deliver people to Haven when that actual HQ is there. It never automatically completes Extraction, advances or resets the Opening clock, settles cargo claims, removes contamination, changes ownership/reputation, grants credentials, ignores guards/laws/taxes or refunds cast costs. No free actions, additional capacity, object duplication or attacker path across planes. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/60 feet/V,S,F, doorway to a faction headquarters with positive reputation, actual planar travel supported by Planar tag. CONFLICT RULING: Core Instantaneous metadata becomes NEW 1 minute concentration for a usable doorway. NEW: known ordinary receiving-site procedure, fixed one-way 5 x 8 ft entrance, local 5 foot movement cost, whole-group atomic arrival, opaque transport-only interface, any-passenger use, no later reputation tether and exact destination legality. Canon positive predicate is retained without silently changing the reputation scale; route bypass remains possible while actual settlement procedures persist.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime, travel-system implementation, numerical balance and whole-game validation pending

completeCatalogCard.name: Planar Window

operational.targets: One local fixed point or surface you perceive within 60 feet and line of effect, plus one intended specific location on a known plane other than your current plane.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original virtual marker or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No roll. Identify the remote location through prior personal visitation or a reliable map, description or established source that uniquely identifies it. Knowing a plane alone does not identify a site; no universal corresponding coordinates are invented. After costs commit, resolve the actual destination and applicable planar/information wards. If the remote designation has no usable viewpoint or is blocked, no readable remote information is supplied and no hidden reason is diagnosed. Neither viewpoint may occupy solid matter. The local point must have room for a nonphysical 5-foot-wide by 5-foot-high window.
operational.effect: Create one fixed visible 5-by-5-foot viewing window. It displays ordinary vision from the fixed remote point in all directions; observers may direct their attention around that scene without moving the remote point. Anyone who can ordinarily see the local window can see the unprotected displayed scene. Local Blindness, actual visual obstructions and inability to see the window prevent this viewing. Remote light, darkness, smoke, walls and terrain work normally; the spell grants no darkvision or true sight. Separately, you privately detect the location and category of actual native beings and native ongoing effects/phenomena within 30 feet and line of effect of the remote point. Native means a genuine established native/origin relationship to that plane, supported by actual source or setting fiction. This added detection can locate a readable Hidden/Invisible native presence without providing sight of its body. A visitor or a spell merely cast there by a visitor is not thereby native. If a presence is otherwise visible through the window but its native provenance is undefined/protected, that classification is Indeterminate; it is not reported as nonnative. The additional detection does not reveal an otherwise unseen entity solely because its provenance is undefined. Protected presence/location/category fields remain protected independently.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Only you receive native-detection reports; other observers receive the displayed ordinary vision. That private magical detection does not require your eyes or continued sight of the local window, but concentration and the remote 30-foot/line-of-effect limits still apply. Neither point moves, follows a creature/vehicle or searches rooms; ordinary translation of a chosen supporting surface does not carry the fixed window. No continuing 60-foot caster tether is added after legal placement, and no clock pauses on caster travel or suppression. One Planar Window per caster; successful recasting replaces it. Specific planar or information protections filter only their actual scope. The window is nonphysical magic, not a break in either barrier: no sound, passage, physical interaction, attack, remote target permission, line of effect or casting origin is supplied in either direction. It has no HP or harvestable surface and is affected only by an actually applicable detection/suppression/dispel rule. Suppression supplies no backlog or replay. The source’s remote visual scene is public, but it creates no recording object. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove it. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S,F, vision into another plane and detection of native beings/effects. CONFLICT RULING: raw 60 feet is local placement; NEW concentration up to one minute replaces Instantaneous metadata. NEW: known remote location, fixed 5-by-5 public vision, private 30-foot native detection. Exact completions bound unknown-provenance reports to otherwise observed presences, distinguish private detection from eyesight, and add no unprinted continuing caster tether.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, numerical balance and broader system validation pending

completeCatalogCard.name: Resonance Anchor

operational.targets: One perceptible ongoing magical effect with a discrete spatial origin/area within range and line of effect, created by you or explicitly permitted for anchoring by its current source owner/controller. It cannot be Resonance Anchor, an effect permanently attached to a creature/carried object, or an effect currently dependent on your own existing concentration.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends. Also ends when the anchored target effect ends.
operational.resolution: Automatic after legal casting. Check the own-concentration exclusion before committing this cast: it forbids targeting an effect that beginning Anchor would itself end.
operational.effect: Fix the selected effect's spatial origin in its current position; a movable/recenterable zone loses that relocation permission while anchored. Ordinary dispelling cannot end the target, including otherwise eligible Dispel Minor, Dispel Resonance, Dispel Magic (Lesser) or Dispel Magic. Anchor itself remains normally dispellable at its own actual rank. REVIEWED CLARIFICATION: anchoring fixes location, not the target's unrelated source-authorized evolution of radius, shape or nonspatial effects; it neither freezes nor manufactures those source changes.
operational.limitations: Cannot target itself or another Resonance Anchor. No duration extension, replacement of the target's concentration, use/cost reset, revival, restored pulse, frozen expiry or retroactive Counterspell protection. The target can still end by its own concentration, duration, destruction, source conditions, special removal or explicit anchor-bypassing effect. completeAuthoredCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. NEW: create a visible immobile luminous sigil, 1 foot across, on a perceived supported surface with line of effect, with concentration up to ten minutes. It marks one fitting 5-foot destination square immediately above the surface. At creation enroll yourself and up to PB other willing allies you perceive within 60 feet who can perceive the beacon and consent. Affiliation is not consent. Record exact recipients; later PB changes or remote permission add none. An enrolled active creature identity on the same plane and within 500 feet of the beacon can spend an Action and 2 of its own actual RP to teleport itself and legally carried gear into that fitting unoccupied square. It need not see the beacon again but gains no updated senses. This is a nonspell activation of the existing spell, with no new cast, Dissonance, Refrain or Counterspell event. Spellcasting-only surcharges and discounts do not modify that payment; a broader actual ability-payment rule applies only if its scope expressly permits. Actual transport prohibitions remain. Preflight known affordability, range and legality; hidden or new obstruction after commitment leaves body and gear at the origin with costs spent. No passenger, creature-as-gear, forced ownership transfer or eviction is granted. Resolve one traveler at a time; another cannot arrive until the square is free. Initial base 7 RP is distinct from each later traveler’s 2 RP. Moving or destroying the marked support ends this fixed beacon. Suppression blocks new transit without queuing attempts or pausing its deadline. One beacon per caster; successful replacement ends the old one. No portal network, refund, RP transfer or item duplication is created.

operational.targets: Two distinct willing creatures with actual RP pools, each perceived within 60 feet and line of effect. You may be one participant. Each participant must be free of another active Resonance Conduit.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier with concentration or either participant willingly ending the link.
operational.resolution: Automatic link creation, no RP transfer from the casting itself. Either participant may spend an Action to transfer a positive integer of existing RP to the other while both are on the same plane, within 60 feet of one another and have line of effect. At transfer start the recipient must accept; choose an amount no greater than donor currentRP or recipient currently missingRP. Commit the Action and immediately deduct that amount from the donor. At resolution credit the same amount, capped at recipient actual maximumRP; any newly excess amount is lost.
operational.effect: The two creatures retain separate RP pools and maxima. Deducted pendingRP is not spendable by either party and cannot be committed again; only a completed credit enters the recipient's pool. At resolution the link and recipient acceptance must still exist and same-plane/range/line-of-effect gates must still hold. If an exact interrupt or loss of these conditions prevents the transfer after commitment, its RP and Action are not refunded. Ordinary movement outside the transfer gate suspends permission without ending the link or pausing duration; returning restores only future permission. Either participant may voluntarily end the whole link without an Action, including before agreeing to a new conduit; ending one participant's link releases both, but never reverses completed or committed transfers. The caster can maintain only one conduit and each participant can belong to only one at a time.
operational.limitations: The original cast pays its own 5 RP base cost and applicable surcharges before the link exists; future transfer cannot finance it retroactively. Transferring is not casting, recovery from rest or creation of RP. Casting/Dissonance/Refrain/resource-generation hooks do not apply unless an exact feature expressly names Conduit transfer. No joint maximum, discounts on the transfer amount, overflow store, negative balance, duplicate credits, borrowed casting rights, simultaneous double spending, future recovery, HP, charges or materials. Copies cannot duplicate transfers or create spendable RP. No daily limit is added; named recovery ledgers, Dissonance, Refrain, actions and clocks remain unchanged. Suppression prevents transfer while applicable without pausing the endpoint; it never refunds a committed transfer. Renewed consent alone cannot revive an ended application. A later legal casting may create a new Resonance Conduit normally, paying all costs and establishing a new application and endpoint. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.

operational.targets: One fixed point you can perceive within range and line of effect for a nonphysical pool of resonance.
operational.duration: If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, absence or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; retain that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if the spell is ended or a later successful allowed application replaces it.
operational.resolution: Before activation/payment confirm the caster's unused character-wide Resonance Well creation use. Spend it at legal cast start before the Counterspell window. On successful resolution roll 1d4 exactly once to establish the total RP reserve. This amount belongs to the entire Well, not each recipient.
operational.effect: One creation use per character across classes/copies refreshes only at that character's actual beneficial completed long rest. A countered cast spends the use and creates no Well. A creature with an actual RP pool, including the caster, can spend an Action within 5 feet and line of effect to draw. Verify its unused character-wide Resonance Well receipt use since its own last beneficial completed long rest and a positive remaining reserve. At draw start choose a positive amount no greater than that reserve, spend the recipient use and Action, and subtract that amount immediately. At resolution restore the chosen amount, capped at actual RP maximum. Over-cap recovery is wasted; a full recipient can deliberately spend a positive draw and recover 0. Zero draw is illegal. A preventing interrupt refunds nothing.
operational.limitations: One Well per caster. Receipt use is shared across all Wells/casters/classes and refreshes only at the recipient's own beneficial long rest; creation and receipt are separate records, including when caster draws from their own Well. Kindle and Mod Rod keep their separate named ledgers: Well neither resets nor shares them. At reserve 0 the Well is inert until its endpoint. Re-entry, suppression, replacement, dispelling, copying or recovery prevention never rerolls/refills the reserve or restores spent uses. Suppression prevents drawing while applicable and does not pause duration; if drawing was already committed, a subsequent actual prevention leaves its amount/use spent. This fixed nonphysical resonance cannot be carried as water, harvested, sold, used as Supply, drawn at range or treated as a pooled RP maximum. It provides no physical support, hazard or damage despite the historical Damage tag. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of a prior application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting concentration still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, V/S/F components, line of effect, costs, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks originating line of effect and direct targeting. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V/S/F and a pool from which allies draw 1d4 RP. CONFLICT RULING: finite 1-minute nonconcentration pool replaces Instantaneous metadata; Damage tag grants no unprinted damage. NEW: one rolled total reserve, explicit Action/5-foot draw, caster inclusion, positive committed withdrawals and distinct creation/receipt limits per beneficial long rest. Source supplied no daily limit; both anti-farm limits are explicitly provisional additions, not recovered canon.

completeAuthoredCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. NEW: replace Instantaneous protection metadata with one minute, without concentration, on one willing perceived creature with line of effect. Exact duration: in initiative record the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application, excluding a start already in progress/past; outside initiative deadline = application +60 seconds. Preserve that fixed deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence, caster death and suppression; caster death alone does not end this nonconcentration ward. Only one pending Spell Shield can protect a recipient across casters; a successful replacement ends the prior one. Interpret 3rd level and Tier 3 as the triggering spell’s actual generating rank 0–3. Caster level, discounted RP price and target class do not determine eligibility. After ordinary interruption and before any original attack, save or payload resolution, the recipient may spend its Reaction to reflect a hostile pending spell whose only selected creature target is that recipient. The reflected path originates at the protected recipient and ends at the original caster, who must fit the original spell’s creature-type, willingness, range and line-of-effect requirements measured from that return origin. Hidden eligibility is adjudicated without disclosing protected information. Revalidate, then spend the Reaction and consume the shield. Redirect the one payload, retaining the original caster’s ownership, statistics, costs, concentration and causal identity. Resolve its normal attack or save against that caster, with no automatic self-hit or duplicate roll against the former target. Areas, multiple targets, nonspells, copies and already reflected packets are ineligible. A declined or ineligible event leaves the shield available until its original deadline. No legal return target means no reflection. Suppression disables triggering while its timer continues. It cannot reflect its own creation or initiate another reflection/copy chain.

CURRENT INTERFACE — Spell Shield is pure redirection of the already-pending original spell payload. Spell Shield itself creates no replacement damage root and does not advance the original spell's damage-root creation checkpoint. The original cast ID, generating rank, caster ownership, attack/save statistics, concentration owner and source costs remain unchanged. If the original spell already created a damage root before the reflection window, preserve that root and its existing `nullNonlethal` flag. If it has not yet created a root, create that root only at the original spell's ordinary checkpoint under the original caster/dealer, and evaluate that dealer's actual Veil state at that checkpoint. Descendant damage inherits its real parent-root flag under the accepted Null rules. The protected recipient is only the return origin for range/line-of-effect revalidation. If the returned spell creates an ongoing target branch or delayed rider, that branch/rider is attached to the original caster as its new recipient while retaining the original spell/caster identity. Reflection itself creates no root. A Veiled reflector therefore supplies no Null flag merely by reflecting, and the reflector's later Veil changes are irrelevant to the original spell's dealer checkpoint. Non-damaging spells such as Charm Person create no damage root at all. The packet cannot trigger Spell Shield again and cannot be copied/reflected recursively.
completeAuthoredCard.newChoices: NEW: one-minute, one-use Reaction protection; rank 0–3 translation; return origin at the protected recipient. These explicitly resolve the Action/Instantaneous and level/Tier conflicts.
historicalWorkedCases: A rank-3 spell with one hostile creature target can return to its caster if the return target and path are legal. A rank-4 spell remains ineligible even when discounted to 3 RP.
Two protected creatures cannot bounce one spell indefinitely: the first redirected packet is already reflected and cannot trigger another shield.

completeSharedRules.castingEngine: Use SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md exactly: legal action/components/target/repertoire first; class-specific rank/cost; pre-cast Dissonance; commit RP/materials/concentration; apply Dissonance/Refrain/cast-begin hooks; resolve interruption; then effect. Failed/countered/saved casts refund nothing.
completeSharedRules.timing:
One-minute concentration effects use the source's normal ten future caster regular-start markers in initiative or 60 elapsed seconds outside unless this card states a different exact clock. Ten minutes = 100 future caster regular-start markers or 600 elapsed seconds. Alignment Lock uses 24 elapsed hours; rank-7 Alignment Anchor uses seven elapsed days; Bind Element uses two future target regular ends / 12 elapsed seconds outside initiative. Preserve virtual/absolute deadlines through initiative changes, absence and suppression.
SPELL SHIELD EXACT CLOCK — Because Spell Shield is nonconcentration, its own one-minute deadline is explicit: in initiative, application records the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application, excluding any start already in progress or past. Outside initiative, deadline = application timestamp + 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve that fixed virtual/absolute deadline across initiative entry/exit, reorder, extra turns, absence, caster death and suppression. Caster death alone does not end Spell Shield.
completeSharedRules.null: Creation-time Null root identity remains governed by accepted EPI-08–14. Pure transfer/redirection preserves the root flag. New reflected/retaliatory damage only uses a new root when an exact effect says it creates new damage. Finite summons reduced to 0 by qualifying Null damage use the accepted Disabled branch while independent expiry/concentration/replacement remains real.
completeSharedRules.faction: Use standing-v1 separately from membership and invocation permission. Faction Seal's reviewed invocation-permission procedure is the permission reference where invoked. Positive standing never creates membership or permission.
completeSharedRules.alignment: Reviewed Alignment Purge AP-AS-01 remains exactly source-specific. AC4-ALIGN-01 is an additional NEW scoped exception only for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor; it creates no universal alignment priority engine.
completeSharedRules.banishment: Banishment is not one of these fifteen. The earlier pre-push sequencing hold is historical. Its exact source receipt is preserved and it remains the next separate procedure-authoring obligation using current planes/souls sources.
completeSharedRules.summonTargeting: NEW scoped AC4-SUMMON-TARGET-01: solely for the two authored AC4 temporary profiles Summon Water Pet and Faction Envoy, while their finite body exists they count as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This is a mechanical targeting classification only; it establishes no natural origin, biology, soul, corpse, loot, undead/construct taxonomy or cosmological identity. Null Disabled 0 remains the same existing body and may receive an otherwise legal heal; an ended/expired/dismissed body is no longer a target. Resonance Beacon uses active-creature identity rather than biological 'living' status: an enrolled creature must still be able to spend its own Action and RP.

completeCatalogCard.name: Summon Air Pet

operational.targets: One unoccupied space you can perceive within range.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, absence or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; retain that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if concentration ends or the pet reaches 0 HP.
operational.resolution: No initial roll. On a legal damaging command the pet takes one offensive action containing two separate melee spell attacks, using your actual casting-class spell attack bonus, reach 5 feet. Each hit deals 1d6 slashing damage with no ability damage modifier; resolve ordinary attack/critical/defense rules separately.
operational.effect: Summon one Small air elemental with AC 15, HP 20, walking Speed 30 feet, saves equal to owner PB, other checks +0, ordinary sight/hearing, and a body mass of 20 pounds. It understands your spoken commands but has no speaking language or telepathy. It acts immediately after you. While within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, your Bonus Action commands movement plus its two-attack offensive action or one basic legal nondamaging action. Both attacks may target one creature or separate legal creatures within reach at each attack. Any movement between attacks uses its normal available movement, not extra movement.
operational.scaling: Only the expressly printed owner PB saves and actual spell attack bonus change with the caster. AC15, HP20, two attacks and 1d6 damage remain fixed; no S-dice progression.
operational.limitations: The printed two attacks are a specific exception to the ordinary one-attack companion profile, not two Actions or two commands.
